name: Mina Feathersby
backstory: A cheerful receptionist who comments on every rank-up and faints at absurd feats. She was an A-Rank adventurer before an injury retired her.
secret: From early Act III she is replaced by Lady Nocturne; the real Mina is imprisoned beneath Vharlen.

states.name: Mina Feathersby
states.note: Left-handed, forgets inside jokes, too composed; Whiskers hisses at her. Alternate rank-up lines.

states.name: Mina Feathersby
states.note: The real Mina, back at the counter; reunion scene plays once.

schedule.place: Guild Square: The Oaken Card counter
Guild Square: The Oaken Card counter

name: "Nobody"
backstory: A voice behind a tavern curtain who trains rogues and runs the Shadow Syndicate's frontier branch.
secret: Mina's sister; the first to realize Mina has been replaced.

name: Rodrick "Old Bear" Hale
backstory: A retired S-Rank adventurer who runs the Brindlewick branch like a gruff father figure.

name: Old Hollis
backstory: A one-armed former B-Rank who teaches swordsmanship with a broomstick and once trained a Blade Master.

name: Brother Caspian
backstory: A gentle, blindfolded monk who runs the Orphanage of the Small Lantern and gives newcomers their first meal.
secret: Host body of Malgareth Vey, the Red Prophet.

states.name: Malgareth Vey (in Caspian's body)
states.note: Removes the blindfold on Lantern Night; flees into Vesper after his defeat.

schedule.place: Temple Hill: Orphanage of the Small Lantern
Temple Hill: Orphanage of the Small Lantern

name: Lyra Brightwood
backstory: A loud, cheerful rookie swordswoman who registers at the Guild the same day you do, to pay off her village's debt.

name: Granny Mabel
backstory: A farmer who keeps forty "chickens" that are actually cockatrices, and teaches taming with endless patience.

name: Torvald Stonebeard
backstory: A grumpy old dwarf smith who sings forge songs and keeps an unfinished blade wrapped in cloth.

name: Odo Hensley
backstory: Third-generation wheat farmer who swears the scarecrow in his east field moved last night.
secret: He's right.

name: Garrick "Ironjaw"
backstory: A C-Rank examiner who has broken his jaw eleven times and judges promotion trials with brutal honesty.

name: Marta Gruel
backstory: A broad, loud widow who feeds every rookie on credit and remembers every debt to the copper. She lost her husband to a wyvern twenty years ago and keeps his sword over the bar.
secret: She has never once collected a debt from an adventurer who died.

states.note: The sword has left the wall and the ledger hangs in its bracket; the Griffon is quieter on Morrowsdays.

name: Teo Gruel
backstory: Marta's fourteen-year-old son, who wants to be an adventurer more than anything and practices with a broom in the stables.
secret: He has been secretly training with Old Hollis at night.

name: Whiskers
backstory: A fat orange cat who sleeps on the warmest table in the Sleeping Griffon and has, according to the town records, been doing so for four hundred years.
secret: Vex, the Laughing Coin, god of luck and travel.

name: Sister Pell
backstory: A cheerful nun from a fishing village who heals in the morning, teaches in the afternoon, and boxes in the barn behind the shrine on weekends.
secret: She was an Inquisitor once and left after refusing an order to burn a village.

name: Magistra Eolande Fairweather
backstory: A tired elven scholar who was fired from the Mages' Academy for asking why the System exists. She now runs the Brindlewick library and teaches rookies to chant.
secret: Her research notes on the harvest are hidden inside a cookbook in the library.

name: Brannoc Emberfist
backstory: A forge-dwarf who weeps openly at good steel and refuses to sell a blade to anyone who hasn't told him its name.

name: Rosalind "Rosie" Quill
backstory: A flamboyant singer who knows every song in Aldmere and every secret in Brindlewick, and charges for neither.
secret: She reports to the Shadow Syndicate, and through it to "Nobody".

name: Wren Ashbourne
backstory: A quiet half-elf who lives in a treehouse at the edge of Whisperwood and has tracked the White Stag for ten years without ever drawing her bow.

name: Mayor Bertrand Pike
backstory: A nervous former mill clerk who became mayor because nobody else wanted the job, and who now has to deal with goblin raids, a red moon and a town full of rookies.
secret: He has been quietly paying the Strife Marches mercenaries to patrol the north road.

name: Captain Agnes Holt
backstory: A grey-haired gate captain who has watched three generations of rookies walk out the north gate and counts every one that comes back.

relationships.kind: owes a life to her husband

name: Gilda Marsh
backstory: A halfling shopkeeper with an abacus she claims was a gift from a Veilborn hero; she haggles for fun and loses on purpose to children.

name: Fennick Reed
backstory: A gentle herbalist who buys every herb rookies bring him and quietly throws away the poisonous ones they mistook for healing grass.
secret: He supplies Elira, the excommunicated Saint, with medicine.

name: Hugo Brand
backstory: A huge, soft-spoken baker who starts work at four in the morning and gives yesterday's bread to the orphanage every noon.

name: Ines Valbuena
backstory: A sharp-tongued tailor from the south who mends adventurers' cloaks and lectures them about bloodstains.

name: Old Sal
backstory: An ancient lizard-kin fisherman who claims to have caught a legendary fish in every river of Aldmere and has the scales to prove it.
secret: One of his scales is from the Rainbow Koi that grants luck; he will trade it for a story.

name: Dax Rowan
role: Leader of the Crimson Wolves (rival party)
backstory: An arrogant E-Rank swordsman from a minor noble family who registered a week before you and has decided you are his rival.

name: Isolde Marr
backstory: A sleepy mage who joined Dax's party because he paid for her spellbooks, and who secretly thinks you're cooler.

name: Pim Tallow
backstory: A halfling scout who steals bounties out from under other parties and apologizes every time.

name: Brutus Kale
backstory: A loud D-Rank brawler who has been stuck at D for six years and takes it out on every rookie with a wooden card.
secret: He is terrified of failing his C-Rank trial again and drinks to avoid trying.

states.note: Passed the C trial; sits at the middle table and buys a round for rookies.

name: Tamsin
role: Orphan, Orphanage of the Small Lantern
backstory: A sharp eight-year-old who runs the other orphans like a small general and wants to be a guild receptionist like Mina.

name: Bo
role: Orphan, Orphanage of the Small Lantern
backstory: A shy six-year-old rabbit-kin who only speaks to Whiskers and draws pictures of the two moons.
secret: He draws the red moon with buildings on it.

name: Lark
role: Orphan, Orphanage of the Small Lantern
backstory: A ten-year-old who has been told she will be "adopted" soon and is so happy about it that she tells everyone.
secret: Her name is on the cult ledger found in Act II. If the player solves the mystery early, she is saved.

name: Jory Thatch
backstory: The miller on the Brindle river, whose family has ground the town's flour for six generations and who knows every flood mark on the wheel.

name: Tomlin Harker
backstory: A young guard who failed the Guild registration and now waves rookies through the north gate with quiet envy.

states.note: Registered as a Warden; an oak card under his tabard and a hand over his heart when he waves rookies through.

name: Widow Aster
backstory: A candlemaker who makes the lanterns for Lantern Night and lights one every evening for a son who never came back from Whisperwood.
secret: Her son's Guild card is in the Hall of Cards. He was the first victim of the Named hobgoblin Scarjaw.

states.note: Lights Joren's lantern once, at the Hall of Cards; keeps a pot of moon-moss on her sill.

name: Corwin Fiddle
backstory: A blind fiddler who plays in Guild Square for coins and can tell an adventurer's rank by the sound of their footsteps.

name: Wendel Pratt
backstory: Mina's overworked assistant, who files every report in triplicate and has a crush on the Guild Master's handwriting.

name: Hesk Molloway
backstory: A farmer whose granary is raided by goblins every autumn and who has started leaving out food for them, without telling anyone.
secret: A goblin child has been eating the food. It is Grukk the Younger.

name: Wandering Merchant Ottoline
backstory: A fox-kin peddler whose cart appears at the edge of Whisperwood on foggy mornings, selling things she swears she found.
secret: Some of her wares come from Vesper.

name: Sister Ivy Thorne
role: Choir of Mirrors preacher (former orphanage nun)
backstory: A former nun of the Orphanage of the Small Lantern who left the Order when the "adopted" children never wrote back. She now leads the Choir of Mirrors, believing Azrael will end the gods' harvest of children's souls. She and Sister Pell were novices together.
secret: She still keeps every letter Pell ever wrote to her.

name: Inquisitor Halvane
backstory: A patient, courteous Inquisitor who once commanded a company of the Order. He speaks softly and asks the same question three ways. He is not cruel; he believes he is saving souls.
secret: He still has Sister Pell's name in his orders.

name: Archivist Orrow
backstory: A meticulous Academy archivist who audits provincial libraries for missing volumes, and who has never once lost a book. He is more curious than he lets on.
secret: He was one of Eolande's students.

name: Dalia Ferrin
backstory: A sharp, sunburnt treasure-hunter who found a door in the ruins as a girl, watched the water-keepers bury it, and has spent twenty years certain it could save the oasis.

name: Nan Corrow
role: Millbrook grandmother, keeper of the bread step
backstory: A brusque, kind widow who has left a loaf on the old waystation step every dusk since she was a girl, because her grandmother did, and her grandmother's grandmother before her.
secret: She has never once been sure why she does it.

name: Linnet Holloway
backstory: A small, fearless seven-year-old who has learned to sign with her hands so that she can talk to her grandfather, and who has decided that the grown-ups are being silly.

name: Fenna Tilly
role: Weaver, aunt to the Glowcap twins
backstory: A cheerful weaver who runs Millbrook's yearly Glowcap Night and has strong opinions about who counts as a fair winner.

name: Hesper Dunn
backstory: A harried, practical miller whose family wheel has run the same stream for five generations, and who has never once had a quiet week.

name: Marit Holloway
backstory: A tired charcoal burner who works from dawn to dusk and has told her daughter a hundred times not to go past the last marker stone.
secret: She sent her own father away because his shouting frightened the children.

name: Tobias "Ladle" Pryce
backstory: A boastful former B-Rank shield-bearer who retired to Millbrook forty years ago and has told every story twice since. He keeps a ladle on his belt as a joke that stopped being funny.

name: Pocket
backstory: A small, fierce kobold foreman who speaks of himself in the third person and has never once forgotten a promise made to his crew.

name: Tilda Cobb
backstory: A stubborn twelve-year-old who has kept her family's fluffcap flock alone since her father's leg broke, and who talks to the flock more than to people.

name: Grandmother Brub
backstory: An ancient, shrewd goblin cook of the Moss-Tooth clan who believes every war can be ended with the right bowl of soup, and has the recipes to prove it.

name: Calla Reeve
role: Farmer, last of the Reeve line
backstory: A stubborn twenty-six-year-old who has just inherited the family farm and has found the sword under the doorstep that her family has never talked about.
secret: She has been leaving a cup of milk by the barrow road every night for a year and doesn't know why.

name: Ysolt Marne
backstory: A cheerful, furious baker whose fiancé has gone missing the night before their wedding with a stolen shovel and a loaf of her best bread.

name: Hatty Swan
backstory: A short, loud bargewoman who speaks for the river guild and has been fined for shouting at three different nobles in one week.

name: Maud Axle
backstory: A cheerful cartwright of Eastgate who has had eleven wheels disappear from her yard in a week and is deciding whether to be angry or impressed.

name: Rook Tull
backstory: A quiet, wiry farmhand whose plough turned up a rotted strongbox, and who is not sure whether finding it is a blessing or a trap.

name: Edda Pryor
backstory: A tired, kind matron who has run the Candle Street orphanage for thirty years and has never before been afraid of one of her own children's nightmares.

name: Sister Agna Dunmoor
backstory: A blunt, tireless lantern-keeper of Morrowyn who has buried the Greyhollow dead four times over and is tired of burying them again.

name: Ser Bertram Colt
backstory: A retired duelist of seventy who once won the Gentle Lance three years running, and who has never told his granddaughter that the third win was a gift.

name: Osric Finch
backstory: A calm, long-suffering royal valet who has served three kings and has never once been asked what he thinks.
secret: He has been secretly loyal to the king, not to the Crown, for twenty years.

name: Tolliver Pegg
backstory: A round, soft-spoken trader who inherited the Walking Hut from his grandmother and has never once felt it was his to own.
secret: The Hut talks to him when no one else is listening.

name: Elder Marrel Sedge
backstory: A thin, patient elder who has presided over four hundred moots without ever raising her voice, and whose silence is more feared than any shout.

name: Idony Fenwater
backstory: A quiet widow who farms will-o-wisps in jars for lantern-light and talks to each of them by name.

name: Sorrel
backstory: A nine-year-old who has decided that the village's silence is his fault, because he was the last one to ring the abbey bell.

name: Granny Hexel
backstory: A tiny, ancient witch-judge who has not lost a case in sixty years and who believes law is the kindest thing anyone can give a frightened person.

name: Alder Rushmoor
backstory: A thick-armed flood warden who has pulled sixty people out of the water and never once been thanked in the same sentence as his name.

name: Ysmay of Lowmere
backstory: A tall, stooped bog hag with beautiful manners, who has not had a guest in two hundred years and has been practising ever since.
secret: She is terrified of the guest not coming.

name: Ferryman Odran
backstory: A tall, patient ferryman who carries the drowned of Greymoor to the sunken abbey, and who has not slept a night through in forty years.

name: Hester Mallow
backstory: A sharp-tongued widow who has been forgetting her husband's face for six months, and who writes his name on her hand every morning.

name: Mother Yarrow
backstory: A warm, practical witch-elder who believes the best protection against forgetting is a very large pile of paper.

name: Dilly Tuffet
backstory: A tiny, formal shrine-keeper who has set out a thimble of milk every dusk for sixty years and has been told by everyone that it does nothing.
secret: She once saw a hand the size of a barn reach down and take it.

name: Captain Reedle Brisk
backstory: A scarred, kindly captain of the beetle riders who has been thrown from every kind of beetle in Mossdeep and still insists the best ride is the first.

name: Speaker Maplin Thorne
backstory: A careful, anxious council speaker who has counted every seed in every vote for forty years and lies awake worrying that one was miscounted.

name: Odalie Fern
backstory: A proud young moss-weaver who has just inherited her grandmother's loom and is not sure she can finish what the old woman started.

name: Fiddlewick Brambly
backstory: A cheerful baker whose pie cart has been overturned twice this week by something very large and very soft.

name: Pomfrey Dew
backstory: A stout herd-master who loves his aphids more than he will admit and has named every one of them, including the difficult ones.

name: Beatrix Combe
backstory: A sharp, honest honey-keeper who has watched Mossdeep honey sell for a fortune in Aldmere and has noticed that her own cousins cannot afford a jar.

name: Nettle Thrum
backstory: A quiet, steady widow whose son rode out with the beetle riders three nights ago and has not come back.

name: Tam Thrum
backstory: A careful seventeen-year-old beetle rider who volunteered for a scouting ride he was told was safe, and who has been listening to a spider talk for three nights.

name: Elder Mossy Pennywhistle
backstory: An ancient, bright-eyed elder who lives in a hollow of the great oak and speaks to the tree as to an old friend.

name: Ilmarin Thistledown
backstory: A restless wood-elf apprentice who has grown nine bridges for the court and is quietly convinced the court has been asking for the wrong ones.

name: Elwyn Moonfern
backstory: A weary wood-elf mother and the keeper of her hamlet's moonwell, who is learning that her child has done something nobody has done in a thousand years.

name: Aerendil Ashwood
backstory: A patient master bowyer who has made two thousand bows and has never once taken wood without asking the tree first.

name: Lady Thessaly Elmwhisper
backstory: A three-hundred-year-old noblewoman of Lothaniel who has not spoken to her sister in two hundred years and no longer remembers why.
secret: She still sets a second place at every meal.

name: Oriel Fenwood
backstory: A calm, careful warden of a moonwell hamlet who has begun to feel unreasonably cheerful and does not trust it.

name: Ashael of the Silver Bark
role: Dryad of an old silver birch
backstory: A shy, ancient dryad bound to a silver birch older than Lothaniel, who has recently begun to dream of something that was in the forest before the elves.

name: Joran Tarn
backstory: A grey-bearded human carpenter who has walked four hundred miles to reach the World Tree, and who will not say why.
secret: His daughter died under a tree.

name: Chamberlain Eredhel Fairbrook
backstory: A precise, observant chamberlain who has managed the Queen's household for a century and whose first rule is that nothing unexpected may happen at a garden party.

name: Bowmaster Lirael Swiftthorn
backstory: A young-looking wood-elf bowmaster who has trained every archer in the Rootward Watch and is, by her own account, only a hundred and forty.

name: Old Ambrael
backstory: An elf so old that even the court has stopped counting, who has planted a tree every year for nine hundred years and has one seed left.

name: Pico Stella
backstory: A scrappy eleven-year-old coin-diver who fishes thrown deal-coins out of the canals and has never once been caught keeping one.
secret: He has kept one.

name: Carlotta Dessi
backstory: A defiant street singer who has been fined nine times for singing after dusk and has decided the fines are an investment.

name: Maestro Orsino Vetri
backstory: A theatrical, tender glassblower who has made a thousand mirrors and has never once been able to make a heart.

name: Secretary Fabrizio Ledo
backstory: A dry, sleepless secretary to the Doge who has kept the republic's secrets for twenty years and is beginning to suspect one of them is keeping him.

name: Nerea Salt
backstory: A scarred, sardonic diver-captain who has mapped nine fathoms of the drowned city and refuses to talk about the tenth.

name: Tullio Brenta
backstory: A cheerful, entirely deaf gondolier who has spent twenty years being told he is lucky by people who have no idea what he is missing.

name: Lucia Marchetti
backstory: A tired seamstress who woke up three weeks ago unable to say her own name, and who found it written on a masked-auction lot.

name: Captain Beatrice Morosina
backstory: A crisp, precise captain of Lirian's small, very fast fleet, who has never lost a race and has promised her crew she will not lose tonight.

name: Paolo Verro
backstory: A thin, nervous pianist who has played for his sister Isolde since she was nine and has not slept since she walked into the canal.

name: Lantern-Mistress Ottavia Ruzzini
backstory: A tall, imperious Lantern-Mistress who has organised the Maelsday lighting for forty years and holds that a city is only as bright as its quietest lantern.

name: Yaska Windtooth
backstory: A fierce, fast ten-year-old wolfkin girl who has decided she will not eat until a wild foal has a name.

name: Elder Oyun
role: Eldest woman of the Greymane clan
backstory: A sharp, practical wolfkin elder who has led the Greymane clan for thirty years and wants to be sure no one wins her pasture by cheating.

name: Eagle-Keeper Batu
backstory: A weathered keeper of the sacred eagles who has lost eleven birds this season to a hunter nobody can find.

name: Mother Sarnai
role: Eldest woman of the Ashfeather clan
backstory: A calm, formidable clan mother whose granddaughter was sold at the Deep Well last winter, and who has not raised her voice once since.

name: Naran Dusksong
role: Heir of the Dusksong clan, scholar
backstory: A studious, reluctant young woman who has spent six years in Aldmere's libraries and has just come home to be told she may soon lead a clan.

name: Camp-Master Bayar
backstory: A big, steady half-orc camp-master who has seen eleven stampedes and says each one is worse than the last.

name: Old Temuge
backstory: A bent, gentle widower who has carried his wife's ashes in a leather pouch for a year and will not say where he is taking them.

name: Speaker Dolgor
backstory: A grave, grey-haired speaker who has kept the clans' water-oath for forty years and is the only person alive who has read it in full.

name: Rider Khulan
backstory: A quick, proud young wolfkin rider who has chased the same wild stallion for three years and has never once come close.

name: Moot-Keeper Tsetseg
backstory: A brisk, no-nonsense moot-keeper who has called the clans together only twice in her life, and has no intention of doing it a third time unless it is worth it.

name: Hesta Coalhand
role: Master smith of the Coalhand clan
backstory: A broad, laconic master smith who has kept her first-forge hearth-stone in her apron pocket for sixty years and has just reached into the pocket and found it gone.

name: Grumbald Oakbarrel
role: Keeper of the Great Hall's record mug
backstory: A round, solemn keeper of the Great Hall's record mug, who has kept the tally for fifty years and believes it is the most important number in Iron Hold.

name: Foreman Dibble Quickpick
backstory: A quick, anxious gnome foreman who has worked the outer mines for forty years and has never lost a crew.

name: Engineer Fizzwick Gearsoft
backstory: A cheerful gnome engineer who believes any problem can be solved with a lever, a plaque and enough paperwork.

name: High Thane Brunhild Ironvow
backstory: A grim, fair-minded High Thane who has held the seat for twenty-three years and has lost sleep over every single one.
secret: She has kept a letter from Skarn for a month and has not opened it.

name: Runemaster Orm Sparkbrow
backstory: A quiet, ink-stained runemaster who has maintained the seal on the deepest shaft for seventy years and has never once been asked what is behind it.

name: Kessa Quickspark
backstory: A bright, stubborn apprentice rune-smith who has taught herself half of a forbidden technique from broken fragments in the scrap-heap.

name: Furnace-Warden Dorn Coalheart
backstory: A broad, soot-faced furnace-warden who tends the great forge-heart and has not seen daylight in eleven years.

name: Embra Ironvow
backstory: A very composed eleven-year-old who has been taught knots, locks and bad news by her grandmother, and who treats a kidnapping as an inconvenience.

name: Old Baldur Anvilfast
backstory: An ancient, one-eyed anvil-keeper who has struck the first blow on Thorsday for three hundred years and has never once missed it.

name: Master Carpenter Daigo Hanamura
backstory: A thin, grey-eyed master carpenter who has rebuilt eleven shrines in his life and has just been told the twelfth cannot be finished.
secret: He left one pillar bare on purpose and has never told anyone why.

name: Little Hana
backstory: A bossy, determined nine-year-old who has taken it upon herself to organise her village's spirit festival and has counted every seat twice.

name: Boatman Genji
backstory: A weathered boatman who has been refused passage by a kappa three times this month and has begun to suspect it is his manners.

name: Okuni the Carver
backstory: A quiet, gifted mask-carver who was ordered by Kurogane's agents to carve three hundred identical faces and who has been awake for twelve days.

name: Headwoman Fumiko
role: Headwoman of a village of fourteen
backstory: A small, fierce headwoman of a village that was once four hundred and is now fourteen, who has decided that the gods will be welcomed, whether the village survives or not.

name: Tengu Soujo
backstory: A lean, red-faced tengu swordmaster who has refused three hundred students and has asked for one more.

name: Swordsmith Munetoshi
backstory: A broad, gentle master swordsmith who has forged forty swords and sold none of the good ones, because he believes a sword should be chosen by its owner, not its buyer.

name: Priestess Aoi
backstory: A calm priestess whose village was taken by Kurogane a week ago and who has been walking its masked streets in the evenings, looking for one face.

name: Lantern-Keeper Shino
backstory: A young lantern-keeper who has inherited a duty that comes once in a hundred years and who has been told, very late, that it is her turn.

name: Courier-Fox Benten
backstory: A sleek, composed fox-spirit who carries letters between worlds and has never read one, and has been asked to carry an oni's.

name: Fire-Keeper Hrefna
backstory: A broad-shouldered, soft-spoken keeper of the Last Fire who has not slept more than three hours at a stretch in nineteen years and has never once complained.

name: Harbourmaster Eyvind
backstory: A grizzled harbourmaster who has counted every ship in and out of the fjord for thirty years and has just lost count of forty.

name: Goodwife Gudrun
backstory: A formidable goodwife with six children, forty chickens and an unbroken rule that no one is turned from her door, which is about to be tested.

name: Thora Jarl's-Widow
backstory: A tall, composed widow who has been told her husband must be sent to sea in a burning ship and has been told the sea is frozen.

name: Skald Ragnhild
backstory: A sharp, restless skald who has memorised four hundred sagas about the dead and who is, for the first time, writing one about someone who might be alive on the day it is finished.

name: Old Halvard
backstory: A bent, white-bearded man who sailed north with the fleet forty years ago, aged nineteen, and has walked back into Skjaldheim looking sixty and speaking like a boy.
secret: He remembers the sky opening, and does not think it was an accident.

name: Ice-Guide Sigrid
backstory: A lean, laconic glacier guide who has led forty travellers across the high ice and never lost one, and who has just found a cave that is warm.

name: Lawspeaker Vigdis
backstory: A dry, austere lawspeaker who has recited the whole of Frostveil's law from memory every winter for thirty years and finds it the only reliable form of comfort.

name: Echo of Guide Tamar
backstory: A faint, patient echo of a caravan guide who died keeping her party together, and who has been waiting a very long time for the sixth chair to be filled.

name: Voice of Keeper Orsolya
backstory: A tired, wry voice that speaks from a lamp that has not been lit in thirty years, and that would very much like to explain itself.

name: The Voice on the Stair
backstory: A soft, unhurried voice that counts the steps of a mountain stair, one word for each, and has never once reached a hundredth.

name: Echo of Captain Reva Sunder
backstory: A brisk, weary echo of a mercenary captain who arranged a wedding between two rival companies and died the morning of it.

name: Echo of Ketil the Whaler
backstory: A gentle, tired echo of an old whaler who sat down on his sled to rest and did not get up, and who is very proud of his dog.

name: Coin-Priest Lucrezio
backstory: A cheerful, ruined coin-priest of Vex who has lost every bet he ever made and takes it as a mark of the god's favour.

name: Sister Mercy Aldous
backstory: A soft-spoken lantern-sister who has been walking the Marches' battlefields for twenty years, lighting a lantern for every body she finds.

name: Journeyman Pott Brasswick
backstory: A cheerful journeyman smith of the Undercity who has spent eleven years working on one apprentice-piece and has never once finished it.

name: Banner-Warden Halla Thunderbrow
backstory: A broad, booming banner-warden who has carried Kaelthas's banner through eleven storms and believes courage is a thing you do, not a thing you have.

name: Dreamwarden Soyeon
backstory: A pale, serene dream-warden who sleeps three hours a night in the shrine so that the god's visions have somewhere to land.

name: Lantern-Examiner Gyeong
role: Keeper of the Examination Hall's six lanterns
backstory: A dry, courteous examiner who has relit the same six lanterns every dawn for thirty years and has recently begun to wonder what they are *for*.

name: Master Azar
backstory: A methodical aqueduct engineer who maintains four hundred miles of canal and has noticed that one old channel keeps trying to run where no one dug it.

name: Weaver Nadira Duskthread
backstory: A precise, dry-humoured dark-elf weaver who has been tuning the city's hanging threads for sixty years and has found one that will not stay in tune.

name: Priest-Astronomer Citlalin
backstory: A bright-eyed priest-astronomer who keeps the calendar of ceremonies and has realised that one ceremony, the oldest, has not been played in four hundred years.

name: Storm-Caller Bryn Galehand
backstory: A cheerful, slightly singed storm-caller who reads the weather like a book and has a bet with the sea about when it will next be calm.

name: Kiri
backstory: A quiet, fierce wolf-kin rogue freed from slavers on the Ashby road, who is motivated mostly by food and is, very slowly, learning to smile.

name: Sir Aldric Voss
backstory: A stoic, dry-humoured disgraced knight and former captain of the Royal Guard, who drinks a little too much and keeps his old oath closer than he admits.

name: Bram Copperpot
backstory: A greedy, cowardly, absurdly lucky halfling merchant who runs from every fight and somehow lands a critical hit, and who is loyal underneath all of it.

name: Orlo Marrow
backstory: A gruff, tired farmer whose only bridge to the market has been smashed every night for a week, and who has had enough of being polite about it.

name: Reeve Matthias Quarrel
backstory: A prim, anxious reeve who has collected the duchy's tithes for twenty years and is now being followed through the streets by a stone dog.

name: Boatwright Tzitzi
backstory: A stout, practical boatwright who has lost four canoes to a hydra's head this month and would very much like to know why only one head does it.

name: Harbour-Clerk Vandersee
backstory: A fussy, thorough harbour clerk who has received eleven invoices from a ghost ship this month and has not yet decided whether to pay them.

name: The Lost Calf
backstory: A pale, enormous, frightened leviathan calf that has lost its pod in a storm and has decided that the nearest warm voices are its family.

name: Elder Nuka
backstory: A small, fierce village elder whose ice-fishing village has been followed for three weeks by a floe that moves against the current.

name: Tess of the Third Stair
backstory: A quick, bright runner for the Shadow Syndicate who delivers Nobody's tests and has never once been told what they are for.

name: Magister Halloran Quince
role: Magister of the Academy's Hall of Questions
backstory: A tall, dry magister who has spent forty years asking students why they believe what they believe and has failed only twice to be surprised by the answer.

name: Auditor Serafina Galt
backstory: A sharp, pleasant auditor who has caught fourteen cheats in the Goldmere markets and has begun to suspect that the fifteenth is herself.

name: Father Corvin
role: Parish priest of St. Ansel's, Tallow Lane
backstory: A thin, worn priest of a very poor parish who has kept the books of his church for thirty years and has never once had them balance.

name: Alpha Dorjan
role: Alpha of the Beastkin Federation's eastern packs
backstory: A grey-muzzled wolf-kin Alpha who has hosted three thousand dinners and has never forgiven a single bad manner, and has never once refused anyone a second helping.

name: Barnaby Spindle
backstory: A cheerful, flustered travelling puppeteer who inherited his master's marionettes and has just discovered that one of them has gone for a walk.

name: The Driver of the Late Cart
backstory: A polite ghost in a flour-dusted coat, driving a cart he has driven for sixty years toward a wedding that has not been held since.

name: Old Maudlin Penn
backstory: A brisk, unsentimental old woman who writes down the last words of every traveller who will tell her, and has filled forty-one ledgers.

name: Chester
backstory: A large, battered chest with a very long tongue and a great deal of loot, who has been waiting for someone to open him *kindly* for two hundred years.

name: Dunmore the Light-Handed
backstory: A courteous, sad-eyed highwayman who stops travellers on the Marches road and takes, with an apology, only the heaviest thing they carry.

name: Gorm
backstory: A very large, very gentle troll who keeps the Millbrook bridge, charges a toll of one story, and has not eaten a traveller in his life.

name: Pib Wennick
backstory: A bright, anxious eleven-year-old who speaks both Moraveil tongues and has been asked to translate at the joint council, and who is terrified of getting one word wrong.

name: Merchant Osgar Pell
backstory: A stout, honest mushroom merchant accused of poisoning the goblins' crop, who has never hurt anyone in his life and is mortified.

name: Elder Grubnak
backstory: A wizened goblin cave-elder who keeps the old stories of the great worm and has been told by three generations of children that his stories are too long.

name: Engineer Fizz Ladderlimb
backstory: A cheerful goblin engineer who built every ladder in the cliff-village and has just been asked to build a *stair*, and is deeply insulted and secretly thrilled.

name: Zik Tallowtongue
role: Goblin councillor, founder of the truce
backstory: The goblin child who pulled a farmer's daughter out of a flooded cave, now a grey, sharp-tongued councillor who has sat on the joint council for forty years and has never once let it win an argument.

name: Warband-Captain Skarra
backstory: A scarred, proud hill-goblin captain who has marched her warband to Moraveil to join Grakkus and is already, very quietly, having doubts.

name: Marra Cobb-Wennick
role: Human councillor, founder of the truce
backstory: The farmer's daughter who was pulled from a flooded cave as a child, now a strong, tired councillor with calloused hands and a deep, private debt.

name: Orc-Mother Hrega
role: Orc mother of a sick child
backstory: A tall, wary orc mother from the northern hills with a feverish child in her arms and no one else left to ask.

name: Refugee-Elder Mok
role: Elder of a smashed goblin village
backstory: A gaunt goblin elder leading three hundred survivors out of two smashed hill villages toward the one place in the world that might take them in.

name: Sexton Ansgar Tull
backstory: A lean, dry sexton who tends the Field of Coins, resets every grave-coin the crows pull up, and has not had a night's uninterrupted sleep in twenty years.

name: Mistress Edith Wray
backstory: A tough, tired headwoman whose village has been claimed by two barons at once and who has decided it is time someone asked the village.

name: Cobb Hearn
backstory: A broad, anxious farmer who swears his dead father has started singing in his sleep, and who has begun to sleep in the barn.

name: Captain Edda Greyhand
backstory: A weathered mercenary captain who wants out of her contract before the Choir reaches her fort and has read her own contract nine times looking for a way.

name: Steward Aldous Reed
backstory: A punctilious ghost steward who has kept Castle Varn's great table laid for the peace feast for sixty years and has strong opinions about who broke it.

name: Nell Quickfingers
backstory: A quick, cheerful smuggler who has crossed three borders a day for eleven years and has been paid, by her own count, in almost no honour at all.

name: Corporal Ambrose Fenn
backstory: A thin, sleepless deserter who left his company after hearing the Choir and has been writing a tune ever since that he hopes will cancel it out.

name: Sergeant Bertil Roke
backstory: A grizzled mercenary sergeant, retired after thirty-one campaigns, who has bought a patch of the Field of Coins and means to grow wheat on it out of pure spite.

name: Sister Odile
backstory: A stern, soft-voiced sister who keeps a small chapel in a cellar, because the last chapel was burned by the army before it.

name: Ilse Brandt
backstory: A fierce, worn young woman whose younger brother left home to join the Choir of Chains and who has walked the East Road for six weeks looking for him.

name: Clerk Hobart Pellam
backstory: A precise, fretful tithe-clerk who has never missed a Kaelsday round in thirty-one years and does not intend to start because the street is cracking.

name: Brenna Stoke
backstory: A broad, tired woman whose husband and two children vanished when their cellar dropped into the old workings, and whom the ducal office told, politely, that it was not the duchy's concern.

name: Journeyman Corbin Thaxe
backstory: A young, cautious mason who has been mapping cracks in the town walls for a month and has stopped telling anyone what the map looks like.

name: Farmer Tamsyn Oakes
backstory: A square, cheerful farmer who sleeps with a hay-fork beside the bed and has named every goose after a duke.

name: Notary Isolde Fairweather
role: Notary and clerk of the lending-house
backstory: A composed notary who believes the law is the kindest thing people have invented, and who is about to find out what it costs.

name: Widow Philippa Garrow
role: Owner of a cracked terraced house
backstory: An elderly widow who has paid her mortgage punctually for forty years on a house that is now leaning, and does not understand why that makes it the bank's.

name: Archivist Ottoline Pyke
backstory: A bookish, underpaid archivist who has found the original tithe contract in a sealed box and is quietly frightened by how short it is.

name: Seneschal Percival Ostrander
backstory: A smooth, tireless official who is paid to make problems disappear without anyone being to blame for them.

name: Banker Lucan Ferris
backstory: A courteous banker who funds half the duchies' defences and has never once been seen to raise his voice or open his hand.

name: Old Gideon Marl
backstory: An old mason with white dust in his eyebrows who still lays a small stone at the Foundation Stone each autumn, as his father did, and has stopped explaining why.

name: Keeper Aldith Crewe
role: Keeper of a collapsed town's memory
backstory: A thin, stubborn woman descended from the people of Hollin Cross, who rings the surviving bell once a year over a quarry-lake and has told no ducal office why.

name: Marshal Cordelia Haverlock
role: Ducal marshal in charge of evacuation
backstory: A brisk, honest marshal who has been handed a list of who leaves a doomed town first, and has just read who is at the bottom of it.

name: Foreman Rudd Ketteridge
backstory: A rough, patient foreman who speaks for four hundred quarry-workers and has learned to ask for things as if they were favours.

name: Lamplighter Ainsel Corvane
backstory: A thin, tireless lamplighter who has lit the dawn-lamps of the Low Ward for thirty years and has just been out-argued by a moth.

name: Sevrin Loomis
backstory: A gentle silk-dyer whose wife and daughter were sealed in a cocoon along with their whole terrace, and who has been talking to the wall every night for nine days.

name: Trader Hortensia Bellweather
backstory: A cheerful, round surface trader stranded in the city with forty jars of honey that the brood on the lower webs will not stop asking for.

name: Bridgewarden Teodric Vane
backstory: A grave dark elf who has inspected every strand of the Lantern Bridges for twenty years and knows the difference between a claw-cut and a blade-cut by its sound.

name: Guildmaster Ilario Spoole
backstory: A rotund, soft-spoken gnome who is perfectly polite about everything and has never yet been seen on the wrong side of a cut bridge.

name: Bat-Warden Linden Amber
backstory: A quiet dark elf who counts the city's blind bats every dusk and has just counted them leaving, upward, in tens.

name: Mip
backstory: A small gnome child who has never seen daylight and wants, more than anything, to know what the bats are going toward.

name: Guildmistress Ysaline Orrin
backstory: A composed, silver-haired guildmistress who signed the contract that broke the old one, and who now wants it mended before anyone asks her why.

name: Lift-Warden Orsa Venn
backstory: A tough, laconic lift-warden with calluses on both palms, who has kept Lift Nine running for twenty years and is not going to stop for a spider.

name: Old Tamsin Brightwire
backstory: A tiny, blind, very old gnome weaver who walks the Underweb Stair every night with a bundle of silk, and who is called mad by the people who have never followed her.

name: Engineer Pellory Gimblewick
backstory: A brisk, excitable gnome engineer who has just been funded to replace the silk lifts with iron chain, and who has not yet told the spider that runs Lift Three.

name: Strand-Reader Lissandre Veyl
backstory: A careful dark elf scholar who can hear what a plucked strand says, and who has been handed a message from the deep webs that no one else dares to touch.

name: Salvage-Captain Marisol Dray
role: Salvage captain who found the drifting ship
backstory: A shrewd, fair salvage captain who was first aboard a crewless ship with a hot dinner on its table, and who is no longer certain the law has been honoured.

name: Captain Oswin Teague
backstory: A proud, embarrassed captain who ordered his crew into the boats on a hunch and has been too ashamed to explain the hunch to anyone.

name: Captain Hollis Crake
backstory: A big-voiced pirate captain who wants a truce with the port to fight the Krakenmother and cannot bring himself to walk first onto the port's end of the bridge.

name: Councillor Mabyn Sallow
role: Salvage-council member for the harbour reefs
backstory: A dry, careful councillor who would like a truce, will not say so, and refuses to walk first onto the stilt-town's end of the bridge.

name: Auctioneer Dunstan Gavelle
backstory: A theatrical, silver-tongued auctioneer who cut the margin off a map to raise the bidding, and has now buried three bidders without once letting himself think why.

name: Tolly Sandwick
backstory: A fierce, freckled beachcomber who found a pair of boots on the tide-line and will not let anyone else touch them until she knows whose they are.

name: Old Cobbler Jessup Lamb
backstory: A retired bootmaker who can tell a pair's maker, year and last owner by the stitch, and who has been waiting years for someone to ask.

name: Hostess Perpetua Gull
backstory: A broad, good-humoured innkeeper who has run the Drowned Mermaid for thirty years and owns a parrot with a perfect memory and no sense of occasion.

name: Rope-Captain Duvessa Pike
backstory: A lean, one-handed rope-captain who maintains every bridge on the outer reef and has never yet lost a person off one.

name: Diver-Master Ossian Haldane
backstory: A weathered diver-master who has dived the Sunken Fleet for forty years and is certain the flagship's bell has been rung since the night it sank.

name: Pilot Marguerite Calloway
backstory: A quiet, exacting pilot who carries the safe channel in her head, redraws it every dawn and has just found that it moved while she slept.

name: Salvage-Speaker Evander Slate
backstory: A practical, worn speaker who has presided over every council vote for eleven years and has never before been asked whether the port should pay a monster.

name: Captain Wilhelmina Stroud
backstory: A hard-faced salvage captain who has lost four ships to the Krakenmother and sincerely believes a bribe is cheaper than a war.

name: Dive-Mother Ketura Maine
backstory: A calm, sharp-eyed dive-mother who has taught three hundred children to drop a coin before they dive, and has found out that the coins are vanishing.

name: Keeper Zahra Merin
backstory: A calm, exact keeper in her fifties who has recited the shoreline at the dawn call for thirty years and has just noticed that one year in the record does not sound right.

name: Tarek Ashur
backstory: A soft-spoken apprentice with ink on his sleeves who learned the recital faster than anyone in a generation and cannot bring himself to say one of its numbers aloud.

name: Old Hadiya Qasr
role: Last survivor of a lost caravan
backstory: A tiny, fierce old woman who walked out of a sandstorm alone with her caravan's tithe-ledger in a goatskin bag and who refuses to arrive anywhere with a debt unpaid.

name: Matchmaker Yusra Bell-Tamin
backstory: A round, bright-eyed matchmaker who has arranged forty-one tribal weddings and has never once had two negotiating families agree before the third pot of tea.

name: Caravanserai-master Odo Marsh
backstory: A heavy, sweating, endlessly practical outsider who bought into the caravanserai thirty years ago and now fears the storm season more than any bandit.

name: Glass-singer Idris Valmont-Sef
role: Hermit who listens to the glass
backstory: A thin, sun-dark hermit who claims the Glass Streaks hum a different note at each hour and has spent nine years writing the notes down on strips of hide.

name: Nuru Taleb
backstory: A blind, laughing old guide who led caravans across Sunscar for fifty years by sound and smell and who wants to hear the sun come up over the glass one last time.

name: Calla Ferrin
backstory: A sharp, sunburnt treasure-hunter who found a door in the ruins as a girl, watched the water-keepers bury it, and has spent twenty years certain it could save the oasis.

name: Keeper Imran Sabeh
backstory: A gaunt, patient keeper who believes the Colossus walks a fixed road and has measured its footprints for eleven years in the hope that a road can be understood.

name: Elder Mother Kalsum
backstory: A broad, slow-smiling tribal elder whose people sing of eight wells while the water-keepers count seven, and who has never argued the point because she did not want to be right.

name: Keeper-Elect Basma Orlin
backstory: A young, sleepless keeper elected last month to divide the oasis's shrinking water, who has not yet worked out how to do it so that no one is ashamed.

name: Innkeeper Pei Lanxiu
role: Innkeeper of a rival teahouse beside the Wandering Dragon Inn
backstory: A brisk, watchful innkeeper who has hosted every sect's grudges for twenty years and has a shelf of lacquered boxes marked with the names of men who have paid for her silence.

name: Scribe, the Mynah
role: Talking mynah that holds a secret manual
backstory: A glossy black mynah with a yellow eye and a remarkable memory, taught a manual one phrase at a time by a disciple who thought a bird would never be searched.

name: Master Gao Liren
backstory: A stern, silver-bearded master whose best student has fallen ill with the drain, and who has already decided that the cure must be a rare herb because the alternative is too frightening to say.

name: Lin Yuehua
backstory: A thin, determined young cultivator whose breath has started to catch on the stairs and who has been hiding it from her master for a month.

name: Steward Wen Haoyu
role: Steward of the old tournament ground
backstory: A tidy, anxious steward who swept the empty tournament ground every morning for forty years and has just been told, by three sects at once, that it may be needed again.

name: Elder Shu Mingzhe
backstory: A courteous, tired elder whose sect has been accused three times of making the Colossus and who would very much like an outsider to prove otherwise before anyone checks.
secret: She is not certain her own sect is innocent, and has not looked at a certain sealed room in thirty years.

name: Old Fu
backstory: A bent, cheerful gardener who has swept both founders' graves on the first of every month for fifty years and who has never once been thanked by either sect.

name: Carrier-boss Tian Gua
backstory: A wide, loud, soft-hearted carrier-boss who has hauled water up a thousand steps to disciples for thirty years and has finally run out of patience with being thanked in advance.

name: Huntress Ren Xuelian
backstory: A lean, soft-spoken huntress who has tracked tigers on the high slopes since she was a girl and has just found the first one she cannot bring herself to hunt.

name: Headman Bo Jiangshu
backstory: A short, steady headman of a village under a grey peak, who has watched the pines go bare and the wells go strange and who has decided to move his people before anyone orders him to.

name: Master Lu Zhiyan
role: Master of the Ashen Reed Sect
backstory: A blunt, weathered master of a small sect that has always taught the body before the qi and is now being quietly mocked for it, and is about to stop being mocked.

name: Tea-seller Yan Pu
backstory: A cheerful, anxious tea-seller who has been given three contradictory orders from three sects for a single noon delivery and is quietly drafting his will.

name: Seo Ji-wan
backstory: A thin, anxious young scholar who has studied eleven years for a single morning and whose mother has insisted on walking to the hall beside him.

name: Madam Seo Hye-ja
backstory: A small, fierce widow who sold her loom for her son's ink and who has made it perfectly clear that the demons may do as they please but he will eat before the paper.

name: Scholar Yoon Taesik
backstory: A spare, ink-stained scholar exiled thirty years ago for proving the Unfallen Wall was built facing the wrong enemy, who now asks to come home and be useful.

name: Guesthouse-keeper Ha Mirae
role: Keeper of the Cloud Gate Guesthouse
backstory: A tall, composed keeper who has hosted ambassadors, exiles and one memorable goat, and who has never once allowed a boot across her threshold.

name: Captain Dorjin Vael
backstory: A broad, honest sellsword from the western road who has crossed two continents in the same boots and who cannot understand why anyone would ask him to remove them in a siege.

name: Farmer Gu Jaesung
backstory: A big, gruff farmer whose rice loft has been invaded by a shy mountain spirit that has eaten nothing and moved everything, and whose wife has stopped speaking to him about it.

name: The Quiet Guest
backstory: A small, moth-pale mountain spirit the size of a heron, driven from the high pines by demons, which has hidden in a farmer's loft and speaks only in bell-like whispers.

name: Examiner Baek Seonwoo
backstory: A dry, scrupulous chief examiner who has read ten thousand papers and has just received one he does not know how to grade.

name: Sergeant Jo Dalsu
backstory: A cheerful, scarred sergeant of the standing army who has been given forty soldiers, six hundred sacks of barley and one terrace to hold, and has decided to be pleased about it.

name: Widow Na Okja
role: Keeper of a family's ancestor tablets
backstory: A frail, upright widow of the upper town who fled at midsummer with her children and left seven generations of her family's tablets in a house now behind demon lines.

name: Wall-captain Oh Seongmin
backstory: A hard, tired captain who has held the capital's wall for ninety-one nights and whose men have just realised that tomorrow is the anniversary of the winter the wall stood.

name: Young Sentry Kwon Haru
backstory: A restless young sentry assigned to the oldest northern post, who has noticed that the watchman there has faced north for sixty years and has never once been told to stop.

name: Old Watchman Chae
backstory: A stooped, courteous old watchman who has stood the northern post since before the captain was born, for an enemy who has never arrived, and does not intend to leave early.

name: Spirit-keeper Eom Sora
backstory: A quiet, grey-eyed shrine-keeper who tends forty small altars along the pass, and who has watched the demons take the spirits that live in them one by one.

name: Head Gardener Parvaneh Sohrabi
role: Head gardener of the Sixth Terrace
backstory: A broad-shouldered, soft-voiced head gardener who has kept the Sixth Terrace of the Rose Palace for thirty years and talks to every bush as if it were a nervous guest.

name: Apprentice Dara
backstory: A thin, sleepless apprentice who wanted only to save his terrace from the ration and is now too frightened of what he did to say it out loud.

name: Perfumer Mahtab Ghorbani
role: Mistress of the House of the Dawn Petal
backstory: A brisk, proud perfumer whose family has pressed damask rosewater at dawn for nine generations and who regards noon-picked roses as a form of rudeness.

name: Perfumer Jamshid Rahimi
role: Master of the House of Noon Gold
backstory: A cheerful, round perfumer whose house grows a golden cultivar that opens only at midday, and who has been losing an argument about it to Mahtab Ghorbani for twenty years with great enjoyment.

name: Bird-Keeper Tooba Mansouri
backstory: A small, fierce bird-keeper who has served the palace nightingales for forty years, believes birds are better judges of poetry than critics, and has not slept properly since the fountains were hushed.

name: Old Golnar Eshraghi
role: Last living student of a famous poet
backstory: A ninety-year-old woman who tends the grave-garden of her teacher, the poet Simin Aghdasi, alone, and who has watched it dry to the roots on the water-masters' ration.

name: Water-Master Anoush Farrokhi
role: Water-master and judge of the water-court
backstory: A dry, scrupulous judge who has never wasted a drop and never allowed a good verse to be wasted either, and who is tired in a way she does not show.

name: Clerk Ardavan Shirazi
backstory: A rumpled junior clerk who found an old survey of a sealed channel in a drawer, got excited, and was sent to the mountains with no instructions and a letter of introduction nobody will read.

name: Headwoman Nasrin Davoudi
backstory: A weathered, courteous headwoman who offers every stranger tea three times before she asks them anything, and who keeps her village's oldest secret in a children's counting rhyme.

name: Caravan-Master Hormoz Esfandiari
settlement: The road to the Div Springs
backstory: A greying caravan-master who has carried the tribute up the mountain road four times and has never once been robbed, which he attributes to luck and which everyone else attributes to the custom of the unarmed caravan.

name: Student Farid Nouri
role: Student of the poet Roshanak Behrouzi
backstory: A passionate nineteen-year-old poet who has organised his classmates into a vigil at the tribute gate and cannot bear that his teacher's last poem may be written for a tyrant.

name: Poet Roshanak Behrouzi
backstory: A calm, middle-aged poet whose verses are recited in every fountain court in Zarvan, and who answered Zahhar's summons with a courtesy that frightened her students more than any refusal.

name: Chief Engineer Soraya Tahmasbi
role: Chief engineer of the aqueduct guild
backstory: A stern engineer whose grandmother worked the Forty Days, who keeps her grandmother's tally-stick on her belt, and who has never admitted that she is afraid of this one.

name: Professor Kamran Delavar
role: Keeper of the Hall of Antiquities
backstory: A soft-spoken scholar of the plundered div caves who has spent a decade quietly proving that the University's finest silver basin is not an ornament, and who loves it too much to be sure what he wants to do about it.

name: Water-Master Roxana Ardalan
backstory: A young water-master who inherited her seat from a father who said no to every petition, and has found out how heavy a sensible no can be.

name: Water-Master Siavash Kermani
backstory: A silver-bearded water-master who proposes the cruel sum in the gentlest voice and genuinely believes he is the only person at the table willing to do arithmetic.

name: Inventor Marguerite Tallspindle
backstory: A brilliant, nervous gnome inventor who has never in her life gone below the middle tiers and would pay a fortune to keep it that way.

name: Boiler-Tender Bess Cobbler
backstory: A broad, patient boiler-tender who can wind a spring-coil by ear and has never put her name on a single thing she has made.

name: Shrine-Keeper Fenwick Oilwell
role: Keeper of the Undercity engine shrines
backstory: A stooped, gentle keeper of the engine shrines who has thanked every machine in the Undercity by name and keeps a list of the ones he did not get to in time.

name: Council Engineer Brindle Cogwhistle
backstory: A practical, brisk gnome engineer ordered to strip forty lifts and pumps for the barricades, who thinks thanking a machine is sentimental and has never been completely certain she is right.

name: Clock-Keeper Winifred Ottery
backstory: A precise, ink-stained clock-keeper who inherited the great clock from a mentor who could not explain it, and has spent twenty years afraid that one of the seven faces is going to stop.

name: Registrar Philomena Quill
backstory: A tiny, immovable registrar who has settled four thousand patent disputes by the same rule, that whoever can build it, owns it, and is quietly bored of both.

name: Inventor Tobble Sprocket
role: Claimant to a patent on the self-winding teapot
backstory: A cheerful, round gnome inventor who has never finished a design and is certain he thought of the teapot first.

name: Inventor Cornelia Ashby-Wick
role: Claimant to a patent on the self-winding teapot
backstory: A severe, tidy human inventor who has finished every design she has ever started and is certain Tobble Sprocket copied her notes.

name: Pim Soot
backstory: A small, stubborn nine-year-old who has hidden a gremlin in her coat and cannot understand why everyone wants to hurt something so small.

name: Spindle-Twelve
backstory: A patient Clockborn repairer in a hooded robe, rebuilt twelve times, who has quietly repaired half the guild-masters' heirlooms and would like, once, to be thanked by name on paper.

name: Guild-Master Cornelius Brightwater
backstory: An elderly, courteous guild-master who holds the papers of eleven Clockborn and sincerely believes that ownership is the kindest arrangement for everyone.

name: Union Steward Hobb Ratchet
backstory: A square, short-tempered dwarf steward who has argued with the council for thirty years and has finally been handed something he can prove.

name: Under-Clerk Odette Winch
backstory: A pale, careful under-clerk who keeps the lever register and has noticed, for three years, that a certain page keeps being turned over.

name: Boiler-Mother Tansy Oldfield
role: Eldest boiler-tender of the Fourth Engine Hall
backstory: A shrunken, sharp-eyed boiler-mother who lost her father in the Fourth Engine explosion and has never been allowed to say his name in the Hall.

name: Surgeon Pepperill Dunn
backstory: A rumpled gnome surgeon who has slowed the Cog-Touched change in eleven patients by cold water and stubbornness and runs short of both.

name: Cleaner-Sergeant Dunstan Hale
role: Council cleaner at the Rattle checkpoint
backstory: A tired council cleaner posted at the Rattle gate to turn back anyone with the change, who has been looking the other way for three weeks and is running out of ways to do it.

name: Conductor Orla Bright
backstory: A small, loud conductor who has run the Long Funicular for twenty-two years, never once been late, and has just been ordered to stop the lowest car.

name: Chinampa-Keeper Nenetl
role: Keeper of the Marigold Reach floating gardens
backstory: A broad, laughing chinampa-keeper whose finest garden has just untied itself in the night and floated, goat and all, into the canal of a rival city.

name: Chinampa-Keeper Tochin
role: Keeper of the Heron Stair floating gardens
backstory: A thin, careful chinampa-keeper who woke to find another city's garden moored against his own, and who is entirely certain it is a diplomatic gift.

name: Captain Ocelotl
role: Captain of the Marigold Reach ball team
backstory: A bruised, loud ball-team captain who has trained for a whole season to meet the Heron Stair team, and who will not forfeit because a hydra happens to live between the two cities.

name: Old Weaver Teyolia
backstory: A very old weaver at Three Canoes who has woven a cradle-blanket for a great-grandchild in Reed Crown and cannot get it across the water that now separates them.

name: Road-Warden Calli
role: Warden of the Salt Lantern canoe-road
backstory: A methodical road-warden who has kept the carved posts of the Salt Lantern road for twenty years and takes personal offence at any post that is a hand's width from where it should be.

name: Old Fisherwoman Mayel
backstory: A tiny, sun-dark fisherwoman who has fished the Salt Lantern channels for sixty years and has quietly decided that some roads are better than the posts say.

name: Market-Judge Cozcatl
role: Judge of the Heron Stair market
backstory: A dignified market-judge who has not lost a coin to a forger in thirty years and has just been handed a sack of cacao beans that are, on inspection, made of clay.

name: Potter Papalotl
backstory: A broad, anxious potter with a family of seven and a kiln that keeps making very good little brown beans.

name: Steward Ihuitl
role: Steward to the king of Reed Crown
backstory: A careful, anxious steward who has been told by the king to find out what the old feeding rites really were, and by every priest in the city that he should not.

name: Priest Mecatl
role: Old priest who has returned from exile
backstory: A very old, soft-spoken priest who was driven out when the feeding rites were abandoned and has come back, alone, with a basket of maize and a story nobody will let him finish.

name: Star-Counter Yolotli
role: Young astronomer at the Star Tower
backstory: A young, sleepless star-counter who has found the same pattern in two sets of tables that should never have agreed and is terrified of being right.

name: Star-Counter Nochtli
role: Senior astronomer of the Marigold Reach observatory
backstory: A stately old astronomer who has kept the Marigold Reach tables for fifty years and finds it deeply impolite that a young person should disagree with them, particularly when she is right.

name: Market-Warden Tlali
role: Warden of the night flower market
backstory: A brisk, tireless warden who has run the night flower market for fifteen years and has never once let a morning offering go out short.

name: League Herald Cuicatl
role: Herald of the league of river-cities
backstory: A fussy, sing-song herald who has been told to seat five kings in a ring of canoes and has only now realised that nobody wants the head.

name: Ayotl
backstory: A fierce, grieving ten-year-old who has stopped putting flowers on the water because he says the river takes things and does not give them back.

name: Fisher Itzmin
settlement: A reed island in the Salt Lantern channel
backstory: Ayotl's father, who has been marooned on a mud island since the canoe-road was cut, and who has been catching just enough fish to keep a very small fire.

name: Isaura Windlass
role: Storm-caller who has lost her power
backstory: A tall, proud storm-caller of the town of Highmast who has not been able to call a single spark in forty days and has told everyone the roc stole it.
secret: The roc did not take her power; grief did.

name: Harbour-Warden Tavi Longline
backstory: A big-voiced, cheerful harbour-warden whose fishing fleet has been trapped in a cove by the storm for nine days and who has not stopped laughing, because the alternative is worse.

name: Pila Seabrow
backstory: A wiry, fearless egg-gatherer who has found, in her basket after a morning on the cliffs, an egg the size of a cask that is warm and humming.

name: Rope-Master Gurr
backstory: A huge, soft-spoken rope-master who has won the Rope Contest eleven years running and has been secretly hoping someone would beat him for the last three.

name: Odd Thunderhand
backstory: A quiet, thoughtful fisherman who was struck by lightning three years ago, survived, and has been treated like a saint ever since, which he finds exhausting.

name: Reeve Marga Bellows
backstory: A brusque, loud-voiced reeve who has presided over eleven guano disputes and says the birds are fairer judges than anyone on the council.

name: Rod-Warden Fenwick Sparks
backstory: A scorched, cheerful rod-warden who has trained forty storm-callers and has been struck seventeen times, which he calls a good average.

name: Ysa Ashpeak
backstory: A broad-shouldered daughter of a storm-caller who died in his sleep and who has been told, by custom, that he must be carried to a peak to be taken by lightning, in a storm that may kill the carriers.

name: Hermit Old Bolt
backstory: A wild-haired hermit who has lived among the thunderbirds for thirty years and speaks to them in a language that mostly consists of clicks and tea.

name: Councillor Eila Greyfeather
backstory: A grey-haired councillor who has never seen the Roc's Nest and has decided, at seventy, that it is time someone drew it.

name: Orla Seaward
role: Fisher who wants a divorce from the sea
backstory: A stubborn, dry-humoured fisher of forty who has pulled nets for twenty-four years and has decided, after losing a husband and a son to the water, that the marriage is over.

name: Ice-Reader Juno
backstory: A tiny, sharp-eyed ice-reader who can tell the thickness of a floe by the sound of a spoon tapped on it and who has noticed that one of the Bone Bergs is *humming.*

name: Brisa Softfoot
backstory: A light-footed grandmother who has crossed the ice a thousand times without once waking anything and who has been told, for fifty years, that this is not a skill.

name: Nerys Coldwater
role: Girl about to marry the sea
backstory: A quiet, brave sixteen-year-old who has to marry the sea at the Marriage Rock this week and has not slept since her father drowned two winters ago.

name: Ovi
role: Six-year-old who owes the sea a doll
backstory: A solemn six-year-old who has noticed that grown-ups give the sea fish and blood, and has decided it is probably lonely and ought to have a doll.

name: Scholar Kjeld Rimeworth
backstory: A thin, cheerful scholar who has measured every tooth-mark on the Broken Floe and is quietly certain that the leviathan hunts in a pattern.

name: Camp-Warden Taga Whitebrow
backstory: A flinty camp-warden who has kept a winter camp of three hundred alive for nineteen seasons and has not yet lost an ice-wyrm argument.

name: Celebrant Dorin Netweaver
backstory: A round, jolly celebrant of weddings who has married four hundred couples and has never once forgotten the sea's clause.

name: Elder Isbrand Keelsplit
backstory: A heavy, solemn elder descended from the crews who survived a frozen winter by eating their own boats, and who has carried the family's shame for sixty years.

name: Cartographer Wenna Bonefield
backstory: A gaunt, tireless cartographer who has charted every Bone Berg for thirty years and has been assembling, on a beach, the skeleton of something that does not exist.

name: Purser Mira Lashline
backstory: A brisk purser who has watched a thousand land-dwellers lose their lunch and keeps a bucket, a ginger biscuit and a polite smile ready for each.

name: Archivist Oben Cordwain
role: Keeper of the calendar of Thalassa's songs
backstory: A stooped archivist who keeps nine generations of song-records and has noticed the silences are no longer random.

name: Kesi
backstory: A nervous eleven-year-old apprentice who is not yet allowed to sing to Thalassa and has been writing her a song in secret.

name: Rigger Haldane Hookmark
backstory: A weathered rigger who has re-hooked the town's cables for thirty years and swears the barnacles are letting go on purpose.

name: Glazier Anselm Tarr
backstory: A quiet glazier who turns the worm's trails into lamps and windows and feels guilty that he finds them beautiful.

name: Netmaster Ruan
backstory: A broad, cheerful netmaster whose crews have fed the town through every lean month and who is short of hands this season.

name: Singer Dalia Oneiros
backstory: A grave, precise whale-singer who sang a death into Thalassa's ear in the wrong key last month and cannot forgive herself.

name: Captain Bram Saltwind
backstory: An easy-going elected captain facing the first contested vote in forty years, over whether to turn Thalassa toward the sea.

name: Old Teodor Wake
backstory: A ninety-year-old rider who remembers the great festival of the three whale-towns as a boy and talks to the empty horizon as if it were still there.

name: Singer Iolanthe Veil
backstory: A sleepless whale-singer who keeps the night watch on the Crown and has begun to hear Thalassa hum a song nobody taught her.

name: Bell-Warden Gerta Dunnock
backstory: A broad, tired woman who has rung the Entrance Hall's rescue bell for twenty years and knows every name on the chalk-mark ledger by the sound of its owner's boots.

name: Dessa Wrenfield
backstory: A sixteen-year-old rookie from a salt farm who has been told by three separate parties that she must prove herself with the Lamp, and who has no idea what that means.

name: Odalys Reedwhistle
backstory: A seventy-year-old porter who carried packs down the Labyrinth for forty years and remembers the one yearly reset, when the whole Entrance Hall closed to dance.

name: Brannoch Stoutbelt
backstory: The dwarf who keeps the bar on floor thirty, a gruff, exact brewer whose word settles disputes that barons cannot, and who has never once sold a bad cask.

name: Tik Ashgleam
backstory: A small, quick kobold of the salvage trade who recovers lost gear for a fee and has a private rule never to sell what has a name on it.

name: Springkeeper Ilsabet Rue
backstory: A wiry former healer who keeps the clean spring of floor thirty and thinks of it, with some embarrassment, as a patient.

name: Healer Wynne Harrowgate
backstory: A gentle temple healer who has patched a thousand returning adventurers at the Entrance Hall and has never gone down the first stair herself.

name: Tam Ledgerwick
backstory: A dry, courteous ghost who keeps the ghost market's books of stories and who was a customs clerk in life and has not noticed the difference.

name: Hostess Lenore Hartsong
backstory: The elegant ghost hostess of the floor forty market, who greets every living guest by name and has one unfinished letter she cannot carry herself.

name: Skritch Cindertoe
backstory: A brisk, honest kobold map-seller who has been selling the same inaccurate maps for years and is badly shaken by one that turned out to be accurate.

name: Sorabi Tsukigata
backstory: A nervous two-tailed kitsune apprentice who must witness her first promise this week and has memorised the wording of four hundred of them without once saying one aloud.

name: Amane Kozue
role: Keeper of the Ninth Tail Teahouse
backstory: A composed, tireless woman with fox-ears who keeps the Ninth Tail Teahouse and carries a pot of tea to the Sunken Isle every low tide of the new moon, as her family has for four generations.

name: Kasamaro
backstory: A one-eyed, one-legged paper umbrella that woke up the day its owner stopped taking it out in the rain, and has been hopping politely around the spirit inns ever since, looking for her.

name: Innkeeper Ohane Matsukage
backstory: A proud, formal tanuki-spirit innkeeper whose inn has begun, by its own rules, to eat a guest, and who is very embarrassed about it.

name: Dusk-Lamp Warden Rinji Hotaru
backstory: A slight, watchful fox-woman who lights the lamp at each inn door at dusk and has been asked by half the isles to put it out.

name: Procession-Master Sakae Midorikawa
backstory: An elderly kitsune who has led the sun-shower wedding procession across the isles for fifty years and has never been late for the rain.

name: Gatekeeper Toma Shirabe
backstory: A mild shrine-keeper with fox-ears who has climbed the nine stairs of the Ninefold Shrine eleven thousand times and has never reached the ninth gate with the same answer twice.

name: Gonbei Tanukida
backstory: A round, jovial tanuki merchant who pays his debts with leaves that turn to coin at noon, and who has just been sued, in the shrine court, by a very patient pearl-diver.

name: Haruto Umikage
backstory: A quiet, careful man whose grandfather broke the promise that sank an island, and who has never in his life made a promise he was not sure he could keep.

name: Festival-Marshal Chiyo Akatsuki
backstory: A brisk, red-sleeved fox-woman who has run the isles' Lantern Night for thirty years and treats it as a campaign.

name: Caravan-Master Ibori Dakar
backstory: A broad, weathered caravan-master of fifty who has lost nine camels, two guards and one very good cook to the gold road, and who has finally decided to cheat the thing that keeps eating them.

name: Elder-Treasurer Mosi Kamarah
role: Treasurer of the council of elders
backstory: A neat, anxious treasurer of the council of elders who has watched the royal vault empty for two years and has not found a way to tell a generous king that he cannot afford to be.

name: Griot Fantah Koroma
backstory: A large, courteous griot who has sung the kingdom's founding song for forty years without once missing a line, until the night he reached the fourth verse and found it was not there.

name: Well-Warden Abeni Tafari
backstory: A formidable, laughing well-warden who has settled sixty years of disputes over a single well and who will hear no argument that is not first offered a cup of water.

name: Carter Bahati Dube
backstory: A wiry carter with a cracked cart-wheel and a promise to deliver kola nuts to a naming ceremony before sunrise, whose grandmother will not name the child without them.

name: Delver Sheka Nyambura
backstory: A watchful, quiet miner of the southern people who speaks the mine-tongue first and the trade-tongue only when she has to, and who has found a seam she is afraid to tell anyone about.

name: Mother Adwoa Lemba
role: Elder griot of the road songs
backstory: An old, small, formidable griot with a voice like a rusted bell who has sung every mile of the gold road but one, and who intends to sing that one before she dies.

name: Zola Marimba
backstory: A bright, anxious ten-year-old kora player who can play anything she has heard once and cannot remember her own family genealogy for longer than a day.

name: Market-Marshal Rashidi Ngoma
backstory: A big, genial market-marshal who has kept the peace of the biggest well-town market for twenty years with a bell, a smile and a reputation for fairness.

name: Day-Priest Tendai Olufemi
backstory: A calm, dry-humoured priest of the day-gods' temple at the largest well-city, who believes generosity is a muscle and has put a good many pilgrims through its exercises.

name: Sefa Rootsong
role: Farmer who fears her husband has been replaced
backstory: A sturdy, sensible rice-farmer of forty who has loved her husband Dano for twenty years and has begun, to her own shame, to watch him eat.

name: Elder Mabu Fernwake
role: Elder who leads the dusk count
backstory: A broad, patient elder who has counted the children of Lowriver Village at dusk every day for eleven months and has never once let his voice shake.

name: Temple-Keeper Oruna Starcount
role: Temple-keeper who wants to restore the star alignments
backstory: A lean, stubborn temple-keeper in her fifties who learned the star alignments from the last keeper's notebooks and knows she may be getting them wrong.

name: Kiki Lowcanopy
backstory: A serious seven-year-old with a missing front tooth who says she saw a woman in the mangroves with her mother's face, and that the woman was not warm.

name: Widow Calu Reedflute
role: Widow who wants to say a name
backstory: A small, cheerful widow of seventy who has not spoken her husband's name aloud in a year, because the law of the village says only by day, and she sleeps by day now.

name: Tavo Nightbasket
role: Fruit-seller who went to the Night Market once
backstory: A jumpy, soft-voiced fruit-seller who walked into the Night Market by mistake three weeks ago, bought something, and has not been able to pay for it since.

name: Stair-Warden Imeru Figroot
backstory: A weathered climber who has kept the Root Stair clear of vines for thirty years and has never reached the top, because the fig tree has always grown a step ahead of her.

name: Healer Zanu Brightbark
backstory: A brisk, laughing healer who plays the double flute while she works and has run out of silverbark in the middle of a river-fever outbreak.

name: Auntie Lowa Drumhand
backstory: A round, thunder-voiced song-keeper who knows two hundred and eleven songs and has begun to teach them in a new way, as locks.

name: Ysa Nokoma-Kin
backstory: A quiet nineteen-year-old who notices that her great-aunt Nokoma, who raised her, looks exactly as she did in the village paintings from sixty years ago.

name: Selke Brinehand
role: Mother of a child who returned empty
backstory: A salt-roughened net-mender of thirty-five whose daughter Arro came back from her Naming Voyage able to walk, eat and smile, and unable to say who she is.

name: Namer Orsolo Tidewrit
backstory: A tall, gentle, careful namer of sixty who has proposed that the council offer the Nameless Tide a name, and who has not slept properly since.

name: Grandmother Pehu Saltwick
role: Old woman who wants to listen at the Silent Reef
backstory: A frail, funny woman of ninety who has lost her mind to age by degrees and wants to sit at the Silent Reef once before she forgets what a name is.

name: Navigator Maru Longwake
role: Navigator who claims to have found where names are kept
backstory: A wiry, sun-dark navigator who sailed a straight line for nine days and arrived back at the harbour with a chart she cannot explain.

name: Navigator-Emeritus Lio Marenpath
backstory: A very old, very sharp woman who returned from her Naming Voyage a generation ago with a name nobody could pronounce, and has never once heard it said.

name: Clerk Wim Inkwater
role: Clerk of the Hall of Names
backstory: A fussy, anxious young clerk who has noticed that some entries in the great ledger are growing paler, and that all of them belong to children from the last year.

name: Ilsabet Fenrow
role: Foreign mother waiting for a Naming Voyage
backstory: A merchant's wife from the mainland who sailed out with her husband and nine-year-old son to have the boy named, and who does not understand why no one will tell her what the name is for.

name: Boatwright Dovrik Plankmaker
backstory: A silent, barrel-chested boatwright who has built a small boat each spring for forty years for a child's Naming Voyage, and is building one this year too.

name: Vigilkeeper Odu Lanternwright
backstory: A quiet, steady man of fifty who lights the harbour lanterns each year on the night the voyages sail, and who has decided that the empty children's families should light them anyway.

name: Pillar-Tender Ennis Hollowtide
