backstory: A lean, windburnt tender who has swept the salt from the stone pillars every dawn for twenty years and has noticed that one of them has stopped sounding.

name: Hettie Ashdown
role: Woman from Aldmere looking for her husband
backstory: A direct, practical dyer of forty-five who has walked the Hill Road twice to find her husband Wilhelm, who wrote that he was happy a year ago and then stopped writing.

name: Baker Maudine Crumb
role: Baker who was once a famous adventurer
backstory: A cheerful, floury woman in her sixties who runs the best bakery in the vale and has begun, in the last month, to dream of a battle she cannot remember.

name: Posy Applewhite
role: Child who asks why there are no old people
backstory: A clever, stubborn eight-year-old who has counted every resident of the vale on her fingers and noticed that none of them is older than sixty.

name: Miller Alwyn Haskell
role: Miller whose mill stands below the hum
backstory: A broad, easygoing miller who has lived in the shadow of the Hill Behind the Mill his whole life and has recently begun to wonder why he never walks up it.

name: Brannoch Hive
backstory: A big, soft-spoken retired sergeant whose old war wound stopped hurting the day he arrived and who has started to miss the ache.

name: Surveyor Ostrel Stonepace
backstory: A dry, methodical surveyor who was sent to re-mark the Hill Road and who has lost two apprentices to the vale, both of whom wrote that they were happy.

name: Postmistress Lisbet Callow
backstory: A tidy, precise postmistress who has noticed that every outgoing letter from a traveller who has stayed more than a week uses the same three phrases.

name: Investigator Dessa Marchbank
backstory: A sharp, kind Guild investigator of thirty-eight who walked into Ashira a month ago and wrote back that she had never been happier.

name: Innkeeper Hob Brackley
backstory: A round, kind innkeeper who loves every guest, and who is quietly worried about the one who will not stop crying.

name: Hale Dunmarrow
role: Traveller who lost his daughter a week ago
backstory: A haggard cartwright of fifty who arrived in Ashira three days ago, hollow with fresh grief, and who is the only person in the vale that the vale cannot comfort.

name: Gardener Lenna Honeywell
backstory: A serene, smiling gardener who has tended the Warden's Garden for as long as she can remember, which is not very long at all.

name: Captain Ulvric Duskwake
role: Captain of the boat-town Low Lantern
backstory: A broad, soft-spoken captain with a navigator's squint who has kept his boat-town together for twenty years by never raising his voice and never leaving a question unasked.

name: Navigator Lisbet Gloamwren
backstory: A pale, sharp-eared navigator of thirty who can hold a town on course by humming one note, and who has begun to wake each morning with a warmth on her face that she has no word for.

name: Bailer Corrin Ropemark
backstory: A stooped bailer with rope-scarred palms who found a stranger clinging to a rock beyond the Glow Gardens and has been bringing him soup ever since, unanswered.

name: Surveyor Tilda Dawnfield
backstory: A freckled, determined surface-born surveyor of thirty-five who came down the stair of the Great Waterfall with a lullaby her mother taught her and a promise to see the place it describes.

name: Gardener Ombra Kelpwhistle
backstory: A wiry gardener who sings to her algae fields every hour of every watch and has just noticed that her voice is no longer enough.

name: Widow Selvi Quillfin
backstory: A tiny, bright-eyed widow who keeps in a glass jar the single glowing fish her family has kept alive for nine generations and believes holds her husband's light.

name: Songkeeper Dovan Echorill
role: Songkeeper who carries songs between boat-towns
backstory: A lean, patient songkeeper who carries the town-songs of the Hollow Sea from boat to boat, word-perfect, and who has been asked to deliver a lullaby to a town that has no one left to sing it.

name: Hull-Warden Sorrin Tarrow
role: Hull-warden of the boat-town Seven Knots
backstory: A heavy-handed, tender-hearted hull-warden who has inspected every lashing of Seven Knots by touch for thirty years and can tell a tired rope by its silence.

name: Archivist Ruvane Undermere
backstory: A dry, meticulous archivist who keeps the rope-knot records of the first boats and has never been able to explain why the oldest knots describe a sound she has never heard.

name: Elder Gwyn Tideless
role: Elder whose mother left on the boat-town that sailed up
backstory: An old woman, nearly blind, who was a girl of nine when her mother's boat-town sailed for the waterfall, and who has spent seventy years not being angry about it.

name: Dill Fernglow
backstory: A grave seven-year-old who has noticed that all the grown-ups are afraid of lights they do not know, and has decided the cure is to meet them properly.

name: Cadet Ceyla Ashwing
role: Young flyer who wants to carry messages again
backstory: A restless nineteen-year-old with grey-and-russet wings who has secretly trained as a courier since the council ended the practice, and who wants her first oath carried by someone with feet.

name: Merchant Bartolo Sellick
role: Valley merchant with a crate for the eyrie
backstory: A tired, stubbornly honest merchant of fifty who has been paid, well, to carry a crate up eleven thousand steps and not to ask what is in it.

name: Vesna Valewind
role: Yak-herder whose son was taken as tribute
backstory: A broad-shouldered yak-herder who cannot fly, cannot sleep and has decided that if the sky took her son, a climber can fetch him back.

name: Stair-keeper Gethin Tallstep
backstory: A gnarled stair-keeper who has counted the eleven thousand steps every morning for forty years and who holds the body of a wingless friend in the lowest hut, because the valley has no ground fit to bury him.

name: Wingmistress Kaelis Thornfeather
role: Leader of the young flyers' escort
backstory: A fierce, brown-winged flyer of forty who has lost four students to the roc flock and has decided that no child of hers will fly alone again.

name: Eldest Mavren Hightalon
role: Eldest of the council of flyers
backstory: An ancient, white-winged eldest who can still reach the highest eyrie only on the best days, and who has not yet decided whether to pay Aquilon's tithe.

name: Flyer Tolvik Swiftrest
role: Flyer searching for a missing brother
backstory: A quiet, lean flyer whose younger brother took off on a solo flight three weeks ago and left a trail of painted stones that stops in empty air.

name: Keeper Ilvane Greywing
role: Keeper of the Ledges of Last Flight
backstory: A grave, silver-winged keeper whose mother was the messenger executed for the contents of a letter she carried, and who has kept the Ledges for thirty years without once asking what was in it.

name: Chart-flyer Peregrin Windrede
backstory: A cheerful, ink-stained chart-flyer of seventy who has drawn the safe lanes between the eyries for fifty years and is now drawing, with growing alarm, the lanes the rocs have taken.

name: Wrangler Rennick Lowperch
backstory: A soft-spoken falcon-wrangler who found a bronze-feathered chick on a lower scree slope and has hidden it in his hawk-loft, knowing exactly whose chick it must be.

name: Woodcutter Torben Oakleft
role: Woodcutter whose daughter went to a revel
backstory: A big, careful woodcutter of fifty who has taught his daughter every rule of the forest and who knows that rules are exactly what the fey invite you to forget.

name: Linnea Oakleft
role: Woodcutter's daughter at a fey revel
backstory: A bright, curious sixteen-year-old who has been dancing at a revel for what feels like an hour, and who is wearing a dress she cannot remember being given.

name: Herald Sennet Quickdew
backstory: A slender, golden-eyed herald of the Summer Court who has never in her long life asked a mortal for anything, and who has been ordered, courteously, to begin.

name: Cooper Merrick Reedmarsh
backstory: A tired, careful barrel-maker of forty-five who made a bargain with the Briar King's thorns for his wife's life and has spent three years paying a price he did not understand when he signed.

name: Mother Isolt Hazelmere
role: Mother of a boy who said thank you
backstory: A sharp-tongued, anxious mother of three whose youngest, a boy of seven, thanked a fey for a loaf of bread and has been very quiet ever since.

name: Edge-keeper Tamsen Mossback
backstory: A weathered edge-keeper who has tended the offering-stones at the forest's edge for thirty years and has noticed, with growing disquiet, that they are no longer where she left them.

name: Nissa Underbough
role: Woman stolen as a child and returned as an adult
backstory: A quiet, grey-eyed woman of about forty who was taken from the forest's edge as a child and returned, a generation ago, with no memory of where she had been.

name: Pathwarden Sorcha Hawthornwake
backstory: A tall, thorn-crowned fey who has walked the forest's paths for longer than the treaty has been old, and who has just discovered a path that remembers a walker who was not there.

name: Courtier Ysmere Rimeglass
backstory: A cold, graceful courtier of the Winter Court who once shared a long afternoon with a Summer poet and has just learned that the poet is dying.

name: Elowen Briarlight
role: Nine-year-old who asked whether it is day
backstory: A solemn nine-year-old who lives in the dusk, has never seen a proper noon or a proper night, and has asked a question nobody has dared to answer in a thousand years.

name: Lady Calanthe Evenfall
backstory: A tall, silver-gold lady of the Summer Court who holds the Last Glade against the thorns and has decided, against all form, to hold a feast.

name: Doorkeeper Brother Ulm
backstory: A huge, soft-spoken monk who has taken the boots of every visitor to the Skull for twenty years and can read a pilgrim from the state of their socks.

name: Brother Casimir
backstory: A watchful monk who catalogues chips and cracks in the bones and has found that someone is taking relics from places no miner can reach.

name: Cantor Sister Ysolde
backstory: A thin cantor whose voice has begun to crack on the lowest note of the lullaby, the one the monks believe the sleeper listens for.

name: Herbalist Sister Marren
backstory: A sunburned herbalist who has lost three fingertips to the lilies and refuses to hire anyone who is not afraid of them.

name: Pilgrim Anwen Greaves
role: Pilgrim walking the whole Bone Road
backstory: A retired courier with a ruined knee who promised her late husband she would walk the Bone Road from end to end and is on day nine of forty.

name: Abbot Thessaly
role: Abbot who presides over the council
backstory: A careful abbot, tired of her council's split between fighting Vyrmax and bargaining with him, who believes the vote itself is the danger.

name: Archivist Sister Perrin
backstory: A dry, exact archivist who keeps the burned monk's book in a locked case and has read it exactly once.

name: Brother Otho Vane
backstory: A surveyor who measures the bones' warmth every season with a brass probe and has just written down a number he does not like.

name: Elder Brother Quill
backstory: A near-blind monk of ninety who sleeps in the skull's eye socket and says the mountain talks in its sleep.

name: Drillmaster Hana Corvus
backstory: A scarred drillmaster who has trained nine thousand recruits and still remembers each name, and who has one recruit this season she cannot make swear.

name: Warden Pell Orrin
backstory: A patient warden who teaches town children the alarm calls and quietly dreads the day a drill becomes real.

name: Quartermaster Ilsa Brandt
backstory: A sharp quartermaster who counts every grain and every sandal, and whose count for Fort Seven is two days short.

name: Innkeeper Gerd Aldous
backstory: A round, observant innkeeper who has hosted informants of every nation and has noticed a guest who pays too promptly.

name: Clerk Tobin Wray
backstory: A young clerk who holds the last letters of soldiers from the two fallen forts and cannot decide how to deliver them.

name: Senator Valeria Dunmore
backstory: A calm senator who hosts the dinner at which the empire's next heir will be quietly sounded out.

name: Sergeant Joss Harrow
backstory: A blunt veteran offered an officer's commission he is sure he does not deserve, because the man who earned it died in his place.

name: General Auric Stolt
role: General named as a possible heir
backstory: A tired, kind general in his sixties who would rather tend bees than be named emperor and cannot say so aloud.

name: Chaplain Merel Aden
backstory: A gentle chaplain who tends the shrine above the carved pledge and has never read the whole text.

name: Watch-Captain Rhea Kordan
backstory: A steady watch-captain whose horns have sounded twice this month for nothing and who knows the third time will be believed by no one.

name: Maskmaker Odile Fenn
role: Maskmaker who reads people by their requests
backstory: A tiny maskmaker who has sold a mask to nearly every person in the crater and can tell what a stranger fears by the size of the mask they ask for.

name: Sweep-Captain Bruno Kell
backstory: A soot-black captain whose sweeps keep the chimneys clear by hand and who has refused Vasque's order to let one district's chimney close.

name: Miner Eskil Drogan
role: Miner who keeps the old tally
backstory: A deep miner who has kept his family's tally of the old miners' greed for four generations and wants it read by someone who will not flinch.

name: Smuggler Neve Lasko
backstory: A cheerful smuggler who carries people, not goods, out of choked districts, and who has one small passenger tonight who will not stop singing.

name: Naturalist Lio Pemberly
backstory: A mild naturalist who believes the ash moths are the crater's canary and is counting them to see how fast the air is failing.

name: Mask Thief Tam Soot
backstory: A wiry thief who steals masks and gives them away, and who can explain why in exactly one sentence.

name: Alchemist Zenobia Quill
backstory: A brisk alchemist who teaches by letting apprentices make small mistakes and who has one apprentice who makes only large ones.

name: Doctor Hale Arvid
backstory: A hollow-eyed doctor who treats smoke-lung without enough clean air or enough medicine and refuses to leave.

name: Old Miner Sigrun Dahl
backstory: A seventy-year-old miner who remembers the first seam and says the fire is not a punishment but an invitation nobody answered.

name: The Whisperer in the Flue
backstory: A smoke-spirit voice that speaks from one chimney and says it was asked to keep something for someone, and cannot remember who.

name: Cord-Keeper Wayra Quispehuaman
backstory: A lean, ink-stained-fingered cord-keeper of sixty who can read two thirds of the Cord House and has hidden, for ten years, how much of the rest she is only guessing.

name: Mason Tupaq Illapayoc
role: Master mason of a terrace wall
backstory: A broad, soft-spoken mason who has mended walls for forty years and has just watched the first wall he ever laid fall in a single night.

name: Chaski Sumaq Rimaypa
backstory: A wiry runner of twenty-three who carries messages along the stone roads and who has just found the next hut a day away, with a gorge where the road used to be.

name: Bridge-Mother Ch'aska Mamanipa
backstory: A sturdy, cheerful grandmother who has led the rewoven rope bridge across the same gorge for thirty-one years and who is short of grass-rope and hands this year.

name: Herder Inti Paucarwaman
backstory: A shy fourteen-year-old herder on his first season alone with the upper herd, whose lead llama has stopped at the foot of a stair and will go no further.

name: Seed-Keeper Rumi Cusihuaman
backstory: A round, patient seed-keeper who holds in her storehouse three hundred and eleven kinds of potato and knows that a fallen terrace has taken the only field of four of them.

name: Steward Yachay Apazaqolla
role: Steward of a great family's work days
backstory: A brisk, tired steward who organises the community work days for a terrace city and who has promised four hundred people a feast on a wall that may not stand until noon.

name: Illari Ticapampa
role: Returned coast-worker who wants to learn the knots
backstory: A nineteen-year-old who left for the coast at fifteen, came home after the great walls began to fall, and has found that the one cord-keeper left in her valley is not sure she wants a pupil.

name: Mason-Elder Atoq Huamancho
role: Elder mason who keeps the wall-lore
backstory: A very old, very exact mason who can name the builder of a wall by its fit and who has begun to suspect that the oldest, tightest walls were not built by any of the families.

name: Cord-Keeper Sisa Condoriqui
backstory: A tall, weathered cord-keeper who tends the shrine under the Giant's Bed and carries a single old cord that she has never been able to finish reading.

name: Lampwright Isolde Thorneglass
backstory: A careful, soft-voiced lampwright who has made two thousand lamps and has been asked, for the first time, to make one from the glass of a drowned child's cradle.

name: Salt-Panner Osric Brinewick
backstory: A stooped, wry salt-panner of seventy who rakes the same pan his father raked and who has been asked for the finest salt of his life by a widow with one week to find it.

name: Nurse Linnet Harrowmere
backstory: A tireless young nurse who runs a low house on the dunes for gatherers found on the flats after Ilyanthe's visits, and who has not slept a full night since spring.

name: Elder Verity Merrowdale
backstory: A calm, long-boned elder who keeps the offering stones of her village and has found the greatest of them gone from the beach on the longest night of the year.

name: Tobin Tallowmere
role: Boy who found a glass-gull fledgling
backstory: A serious nine-year-old who has rescued a glass-gull chick from the foam and is determined to return it before the next tide, whatever the grown-ups say.

name: Singer Corwen Tidesong
backstory: A grey, gentle singer who is the last on the coast who remembers the songs in the key they were sung in before the red moon rose, and who has begun to forget the third verse.

name: Guild-Warden Marrek Soltane
backstory: A broad, practical guild-warden who counts the guild's gatherers every dusk and who has set a night watch on a mile of beach where the glass has begun to dim.

name: Naturalist Ilsabet Ferrow
backstory: A thin, cheerful naturalist who has counted the moon-moths of the Glass Flats each autumn for eleven years and who has noticed they are flying in a new direction.

name: Beachkeeper Marit Dunmore
backstory: A weathered woman who has tended one stretch of glass beach for forty years and who is sitting beside it, night after night, because it went out in a single tide and she will not leave it alone.

name: Lamp-Keeper Perpetua Vask
role: Keeper of the Lamp Market's oldest lamp
backstory: A tall, composed lamp-keeper who has tended the Market's first lamp for thirty years and who has begun to see, once an hour, something move inside it.

name: Tremor-Reader Maud Thrane
backstory: A small, dry, stubborn tremor-reader of fifty who has predicted a great quake in nine days from the way a bowl of water shivers, and whose own town council has stopped inviting her to speak.

name: Town-Warden Gideon Ropewright
role: Warden of a town that must move
backstory: A broad, soft-voiced warden who has to take two thousand people and their rope-houses across Quakeback's Ridge before the cracked spring fails, and who has never moved a town more than a mile.

name: Wick Larkspur
role: Child who sings to the ground
backstory: A quiet seven-year-old who hums to the floor whenever it shakes, and has noticed that sometimes, only sometimes, it stops.

name: Spring-Keeper Hanne Veld
backstory: A weathered keeper of a small spring-town whose pool has stayed still through every quake for sixty years, and who is now being asked to share it with three hundred strangers.

name: Rope-Wright Dunstan Pellow
backstory: A cheerful, scarred rope-wright who has moved the same house eleven times and who has promised an old woman that her house will be down and up again in a single day.

name: Map-Maker Ambrose Quenby
backstory: A tall, quiet map-maker who copies the Stillers' oldest maps, every one of them wrong, and who has just found one that is wrong in a way he cannot explain.

name: Crystal-Trader Dacian Moorfield
backstory: A sunburnt trader who buys the strange crystals the quakes bring up and who has been paid a great deal to carry one that will not stop humming.

name: Ewart Longmeadow
role: Stiller who cannot sleep in calm
backstory: A gentle thirty-year-old carter who sleeps like a child through a tremor and has not slept one night in the three weeks the ground has been still.

name: Watch-Captain Rhys Cairnford
role: Watch-captain of the New Gorge crossing
backstory: A lean, dry watch-captain who has kept the rope-ferry across the New Gorge for twelve years and who expects the next aftershock to bring the stone beasts out of the cracks.

name: Elder Reader Bertram Greywether
backstory: A very old, very patient reader who has counted the breaths of Quakeback's Ridge for fifty years, and who has noticed that the count is no longer even.

name: Diver Pell Ashgrove
role: Diver whose partner was turned to gold
backstory: A lean, sleepless diver of thirty-four who has dived twelve seasons beside Dunmore Reck and who found him smiling in a theatre seat, solid gold from collar to boots, three days ago.

name: Tilda Vantoor
role: Survivor's descendant and keeper of the family records
backstory: A precise, quiet woman of fifty whose grandmother was outside the kingdom on the night it sank and who has spent her life wanting one fact: what the Magician promised the king.

name: Diver Oskar Tidewell
role: Deep diver who saw a man on the throne
backstory: A broad, shaken diver who has gone deeper than anyone in the camp and who swears he saw the king sitting in the flooded throne room, upright, waiting.

name: Cook Dagobert Kettle
role: Camp cook who hosts the vigil table
backstory: A stout, soft-spoken cook who feeds a hundred explorers a day and who sets one extra chair at his long table every year on the anniversary of the sinking, for the families who never ask him to.

name: Tamsin Quill
role: Child who tends the coin step
backstory: A grave nine-year-old who sweeps the first step of the water each dawn and keeps a tally of the coins left there for the dead, and who has noticed the tally is wrong.

name: Assayer Garrick Lathe
backstory: A fussy, honest gnome who tests every ingot that comes up the Long Stair and who has been handed three bars this month that turned to paint by morning.

name: Arbiter Marit Deepclaim
backstory: A broad-shouldered former diver who now settles claim disputes for the explorers' council and who has never lost a ruling she made in the water.

name: Lady Merewen Verrane
role: One of the polite dead, holder of an unfinished dance
backstory: A courtly, confused lady in a gown of pale gold who has waited in the Hall of Mirrors for a hundred and some years for her partner to return and finish the last dance on her card.

name: Scholar Lucan Marsh
backstory: A mild, damp-sleeved scholar who studies the blind white fish and cave eels of the lamp-lit streets and who has noticed that their numbers fall whenever a lamp dies.

name: Porter-Captain Hesper Gladewick
role: Captain of the Long Stair porters
backstory: A square, patient captain who keeps two hundred porters and a thousand steps alive and who knows every shrine on the stair by the chips in its stone.

name: Innkeeper Vesk Ambermaw
backstory: A broad, soft-spoken demon of sixty with curved horns worn smooth at the tips, who has run the Crimson Rest's cellar kitchen for thirty years and has quietly hidden a frightened human deserter in it for three weeks.

name: Corporal Edrin Rook
backstory: A thin, nineteen-year-old human corporal who walked away from a bad battle two months ago and who has learned to bake bread in the cellar of a demon inn.

name: Forge-wright Dathrak Cindermoor
role: Forge-wright and father of a runaway
backstory: A heavy, anxious smith whose eight-year-old son left in the night with a satchel of bread and a list of questions about humans, and who has been told to expect the worst.

name: Mason Karrow Slate
role: Mason who tends a ruined fortress
backstory: A sad, steady mason who mends the cracked walls of an old fortress no one uses and who has been carving, each night for a year, a face on a headless hero's statue.

name: Farmer Brukka Ashfield
backstory: A short, stubborn farmer with a clay pipe and four grandchildren who has until Friday to bring in a harvest the army will requisition on Saturday, and whose hired hands have all been conscripted.

name: Wellkeeper Ysmira Dawnwell
backstory: A weathered, practical demon who keeps the only well that serves both the refugee camps on either side of a border town and who has refused to let either side claim the rope.

name: Grandmother Selka Embertongue
role: Elder who prays to the day-gods
backstory: A tiny, very old demon who has whispered prayers to the day-gods under the floorboards every dawn of her life and who now fears her granddaughter has noticed.

name: Shift-Boss Brannic Glassvein
backstory: A grave, grey-horned shift-boss who has lost nobody in his tunnels in eleven years and who now has fourteen miners behind a collapse and a rule against asking for help.

name: Merchant Zahlia Brightscale
backstory: A quick, careful merchant who has kept honest books for twenty years and who has just been handed a requisition ledger that cannot be right.

name: Scholar Ivrel Sootquill
backstory: A hunched, eager scholar of the ruined fortresses of the Hero's Road who has spent nine years copying what the heroes of past ages scratched on the walls and who has found something no one meant to leave.

name: Bard Nerezza Lowflame
backstory: A husky-voiced bard who plays at both ends of a border town for coin and who has noticed that a lullaby the demon children sing is the same one human prisoners hum.

name: Cartographer Brevin Tarrant
backstory: A dry, tireless guild cartographer who has charted eleven Calamity trails and has never once spoken a monster's name on the grass, and who keeps a notebook of the descriptions she uses instead.

name: Offering-Keeper Ruuk Dawnpaw
role: Wolfkin offering-keeper at the steppe's edge
backstory: A grey-muzzled Wolfkin of the eastern clans who has laid offerings on the steppe's edge for fifty years and who has begun to suspect that something out there has started leaving offerings back.

name: Tower-Warden Cadogan Pike
role: Warden of the northernmost guild watchtower
backstory: A stooped, methodical warden who counts the Calamities leaving the steppe and who has spent the year staring at a chart on which every trail bends the same way.

name: Scholar Fitzroy Amberlane
backstory: A cheerful, ink-stained scholar who has watched the giants fight over salt for three seasons from a hide a mile off and who has decided, against all advice, to get closer.

name: Hermit Bellamy Quarrel
role: Hermit who grows a garden in a crater
backstory: A weathered, polite hermit of seventy who walked onto the steppe nine years ago to die and has instead been growing peas in a footprint-crater, undisturbed by anything.

name: Skywatcher Corra Windfall
backstory: A lean, patient watcher who has spent six years counting the huge birds that ride the thermals and who needs one of their shed feathers for the guild's collection.

name: Caravan-Mistress Dunya Ironwheel
role: Mistress of an armoured steppe caravan
backstory: A stout, unflappable caravan-mistress who has crossed the steppe nineteen times with a wagon train of S-rank scholars and who has just lost a wagon through the ground.

name: Bone-Reader Jorun Tuskward
backstory: A quiet, lanky scholar who reads old bone as others read books and who has walked the ring of the Tusks nineteen times, counting the footprints.

name: Captain Rhosyn Fellowes
role: Expedition captain looking for a grave
backstory: A grim, careful captain whose younger brother died on the steppe six years ago and who has come back with a coil of rope and a star-chart to find the cairn the grass has since closed.

name: Beastmaster Wrenna Grassmantle
backstory: A calm, grass-stained beastmaster who has followed a single lost behemoth calf across the steppe for a month and who will not let it be eaten.

name: Breath-Counter Harl Brennick
role: Chief breath-counter of the Watch Camp
backstory: A stooped, soft-spoken counter who has logged thirty-one years of breaths in the Breath Ledger and who has, this season, started hearing a rhythm that is not in the count.

name: Marshal Dagna Fenwick
backstory: A broad, tired marshal with a scar through one eyebrow who sent a party of S-rank friends into the Throat and has kept their lantern lit for forty days.

name: Piet Haldane
backstory: A patient, weathered farmer who refuses to leave land his family has ploughed for six generations, even though his barley field dropped a foot overnight and something beneath it hums.

name: Archivist Ibb Quillon
backstory: A small, ink-stained archivist who keeps the Breath Ledger dry, ordered and honest, and who believes the Throat's resin remembers every pressure that has ever touched it.

name: Surveyor Sabeth Corran
role: Land surveyor of the sinking Rim
backstory: A brisk, dry-humoured surveyor who has measured the Rim's slope every month for nine years and who is quietly certain the land is sinking in steps, not in a slide.

name: Quartermaster Halvard Stone
backstory: A gruff quartermaster who feeds two hundred watchers, and who has noticed that the number who ask for transfers has doubled since the breathing quickened.

name: Scholar Tessaly Mourne
backstory: A precise, curious elf scholar who has spent a century drawing the swarm's workers and who has just drawn one she cannot explain.

name: Ottoline Reeve
backstory: A quiet seventy-year-old who was a girl when the swarm stripped the Third Province, who still has her mother's house-bell, and who has never been allowed to ring it.

name: Captain Brannoch Gale
backstory: A thick-armed dwarf captain who has led two hundred descents and who has, lately, begun to count the soldiers that stop and wait for him to leave.

name: Night-Watcher Wyl Ashgrove
backstory: A young, serious night-watcher who has a perfect ear for the breath and was the first to notice that the pause between the in-breath and the out-breath is getting longer.

name: Sister Lioba Wren
backstory: A careful, soft-voiced sister who tends the shard of root-light in the Church treasury and who has noticed, with a jeweller's eye, that its glow reaches a little further each spring.

name: Cass Thornby
backstory: A cheerful, scarred ranger who has reached the Root three times and who swears, quietly and without drama, that the third time she heard someone weeping inside the Cracked Root.

name: Gloam
role: Ancient slime that learned to speak
backstory: A vast, patient slime the colour of old glass that has drifted among the roots for longer than there have been records, and that has recently learned enough words to want to be heard.

name: Rook Ellery
backstory: A lean, wry mapper who has charted forty of the Crystal Bridges for the guild and who speaks to each one by name before stepping onto it.

name: Pilgrim-Priest Ketil Anvard
backstory: A stout, gentle dwarf priest who has walked down a mile of stairs to see the Kneeling Stones, where his people say the first anvil stood, and who has brought two guests of other faiths.

name: Isaure Venn
backstory: A grave, eloquent elf druid whose grove is dying and who has come to ask the Root, with great courtesy, for one small cutting of its light.

name: Pernel Gray
backstory: A plain, steady courier who carries the last letters of lost adventurers to their families and who has one letter left whose writer lies somewhere beyond the Crystal Bridges.

name: Davos Quenby
backstory: A quiet, bookish scholar who has traced the ancestry of an elder draconic being at the Root through nine dead languages and believes he has found its name.

name: Imke Sorrowby
backstory: A brisk, nearsighted linguist who has transcribed a dozen constructs' commands and who has been refused entry by one bridge-gate for three expeditions because she cannot recall its word.

name: Archivist Odalys Reik
backstory: A methodical archivist who measures everything and who has, on her last expedition, measured the two Kneeling Stones and been unable to put the numbers away.

name: Scholar Tobias Wickham
backstory: A rumpled, kindly scholar who spent thirty years arguing over the dark marks on the red moon's face and who has lately received a map of those marks that matches a city on no map of the world.

name: Sorrel
backstory: A slender, softly glowing vesperite who followed an adventurer down to the surface once, came back, and is now searching the ruins for a person whose name it has only half heard.

name: Hester Lamm
role: Old woman who knows the song
backstory: A tiny, sharp-eyed woman of ninety who hums a lullaby her grandmother sang and who was stopped dead, at the market, when a visitor played her a song-crystal of the red flowers' song.

name: Cador Fell
backstory: A patient, soft-spoken delver who has copied nine hundred name-plates from the doors of the Broken Streets and who is certain that someone, someday, will want them.

name: Pilot Gawen Trelawn
backstory: A laconic half-elf pilot who has crossed the Floating Quarter's drifting stones eleven times, and who talks to the stones in a low, dry voice as if they were temperamental mules.

name: Priest Petronel Voss
backstory: A tall, gentle priest who has preached on the red moon for twenty years and who has come to stand under it for the first time, nervous and a little ashamed of how little he knows.

name: Wilmot Crane
backstory: A round, floury ghost who keeps opening a bakery in the Broken Streets every dawn, setting out loaves that are not there, and greeting customers who do not come.

name: Cartographer Dessa Orrin
backstory: A square-shouldered cartographer who has mapped the moon's approach to the last inch and who is troubled that the last inch of her map, every time she redraws it, ends in a straight, deliberate line.

name: Margit Sallow
backstory: A weathered mother of sixty who walked to the way-camp when the moon opened, carrying the lantern her son took with him on his last expedition, and has not slept since.

name: Historian Thaddeus Nole
role: Collector of memories of the moon
backstory: A precise, white-haired historian who has spent a decade collecting what people say they remember of the moon, and who has found that no two accounts of its colour agree.

name: Scholar Ysmere Quillbrook
backstory: A rumpled, patient scholar who has spent three seasons at the Titan banquet hall and wants only to know what the feast was going to be.

name: Hermit Oswin Thistlewake
role: Hermit who feeds a trapped sky whale
backstory: A weathered hermit who has camped beside a ruined tower for two seasons, singing to the sky whale caught in its stairwell.

name: Bridge-Warden Sereth Skyhand
role: Heavenfolk warden of the Broken Bridges
backstory: A grave Heavenfolk who counts the bridges each month and is uneasy that one of them is getting longer.

name: Licence-Officer Mirelle Tarn-Voss
backstory: A brisk, tired guild officer who issues licences for the archipelago and is tired of being shouted at by both scholars and Heavenfolk.

name: Elder Quillon Aerith
role: Heavenfolk elder who speaks for the sacred islands
backstory: A tall, dry-humoured Heavenfolk elder who dislikes visitors on principle and has never once refused a good argument.

name: Quartermaster Dessa Kell
role: Quartermaster of a stranded scavenger crew
backstory: A square, practical quartermaster whose airship lost its lift stones three weeks ago and who has rationed forty people on the same hall of white stone.

name: Old Ruan Pelt
role: Hermit who has stayed too many seasons
backstory: A cheerful old hermit who has camped on one terrace for nine seasons and has begun to lose the names of ordinary things.

name: Botanist Halloran Vesper-Moss
backstory: A small, tireless botanist who has catalogued eleven trees that grow their fruit toward the sky and one that does not.

name: Edda Brightmantle
role: Daughter of the expedition leader who brought back a Titan knife
backstory: A quiet woman of sixty whose mother carried a Titan's table knife down from the Highest Island and who has never forgiven the knife for being the reason her mother left again.

name: Songwright Calder Windfall
role: Songwright who listens to the wind serpents
backstory: A thin, restless songwright who has transcribed the wind serpents' nightly choir in an amphitheatre built for far larger audiences.

name: Stormwatcher Veyra Cloudmantle
backstory: A calm Heavenfolk who has watched the circling storm for eleven years and has begun to suspect that it is counting.

name: Mason Odrun Flintlay
role: Mason who found a flaw in the new ring's footing
backstory: A broad, careful dwarf mason with forty years of wall behind him who knows exactly how a footing is poisoned and by whom.

name: Tarn Hollowgrass
backstory: A lean wolfkin rider of the Steppe Horde who walked into the outer ring under a white cloth with a message he will only give to the Warden.

name: Warden Ysolt Greywall
backstory: A sparse, hard-voiced Warden chosen by the captains of the rings, who sleeps four hours a night and keeps a list of every captain who has died holding the outer wall.

name: Farmwife Hesper Furrow-Reeve
role: Farmwife with a field no one can reach
backstory: A weathered farmwife who has harvested the same barley field for thirty years and sees no reason that a horde should stop her.

name: Captain Joram Vellacott
backstory: The honoured, tired captain of the outer ring, who has buried six lieutenants and is determined not to bury a seventh without understanding why the walls fall.

name: Sergeant Mab Thistlewick
backstory: A stout halfling sergeant whose militia of thirty has held a village between rings for four summers by habit, fury and pie.

name: Widow Ansa Keelgrave
role: Widow of a fallen outer-ring captain
backstory: A tall, quiet widow whose husband held the outer wall for nine years and whose family has not yet been given a place in the next one.

name: Ring-Captain Teodra Mossgate
backstory: A clear-eyed inner-ring captain who thinks the outer ring is a grave being dug one soldier at a time and has said so, in public, to the Warden.

name: Archivist Perdita Underhill
backstory: A bright, dusty archivist who keeps the records of the first fort and has just found a floor plan that does not match any gate in the city.

name: Wren Gravelmouth
role: Nine-year-old scavenger of the Broken Rings
backstory: A fierce nine-year-old who hunts for useful scrap among the broken rings and has found something that purrs.

name: Master Mason Berwyn Stonehall
role: Master mason of the next ring
backstory: A stooped master mason with plaster in his beard who has laid the foundation of eight rings and knows to the hour how long the next one needs.
